Title: Senior Business Analytics Specialist
Description:
Overview

Commercial Engineering & AI (CEAI) partners closely with stakeholders to accelerate the transformation of Microsoft’s commercial business into a frontier organization. We bring together AI‑native engineering, modern platforms, and deep commercial insight to reimagine how work gets done - at scale and with impact. Our mission is to unlock new ways of operating through intelligent systems while creating the conditions for our teams to do the most meaningful work of their careers. If you’re excited to build, experiment, and shape the future of commercial execution with AI at the core, we invite you to apply.

The Business Intelligence Center of Excellence (BI COE) is responsible for delivering AI-first, enterprise-scale analytics that power data-driven decision-making across Microsoft’s Partner and Seller ecosystem. Our mission is to transform fragmented data into a single, trusted source of truth, enabling actionable insights, automation, and intelligent experiences.

The successful candidate for this role will lead the Security BI, data analytics & insights for the team globally, supporting leadership as well as Corporate & field teams, driving next level intelligent insights and predictive analytics around the business, led and scaled through AI across multi-modal interfaces. This role will also partner directly with the other members of our BI COE Team to deliver integrated, AI-led insights solutions, not proliferating or creating duplicative, isolated, or “more” interfaces in isolation.

You will play a role in shaping the next generation of AI-powered BI solutions, leveraging Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and semantic modelling to deliver scalable, high-performance, and governed analytics experiences.

Responsibilities


Interpret complex business problems and requirements, translating them into capability needs, then building/ enabling AI-ready semantic layers that support natural language querying, automation, and predictive insights to enable AI-driven insights, Copilot scenarios, and intelligent analytics experiences leveraging Fabric, Power BI, GHCP, Cowork, CLI and more to solve these business problems
Enable AI-led predictive analytics capabilities and data insights for sellers, managers, and leadership to understand actionable insights and how to best use it to achieve measurable results. (What they need to know, Why they need to know it, and What they need to do about it)
Integrate and work with BI COE team members and stakeholders to identify, understand, and prioritize business and information needs
Utilize/deliver standardized tools and reporting which enable speed, efficiency, and scale in the business to accelerate the standardized business operations vs. isolated, disconnected, or duplicative solutions
Locate and define new process improvement opportunities and solve for root cause business issues to locate and correct problems
Drive adoption of AI-first principles across BI COE analytics and reporting solutions.


Impact & Outcomes


Deliver a unified, AI-powered analytics platform for Security insights
Enable single source of truth (OSOT) across data solutions
Reduce time-to-insight through optimized semantic models and self-service BI
Drive adoption of Fabric + AI-first BI strategy across BI COE


Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

Master's Degree in Mathematics, Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, Business, Economics or related field AND 3+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Finance, Mathematics, Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, Business, Economics or related field AND 4+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualificaitons


8+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, or Analytics
Experience in:
Semantic modeling (Power BI / Tabular / DAX)
Data architecture and dimensional modeling (star schema, OSOT principles)
Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Direct Lake, pipelines, OneLake)
Power BI (dataset optimization, reporting, governance)
Experience building analytics solutions at scale.
Experience with data governance, security, and compliance framework.
Experience in Microsoft Sales ecosystem.
Experience with AI-driven BI scenarios (Copilot, predictive analytics, data agents).
Experience integrating multiple enterprise datasets into unified reporting models.
Experience operating in matrixed, cross-functional environments and influence stakeholders.
Storytelling skills with experience to translating data into business impact.

Title: Senior Business Operations Associate
Description:
About DAT

DAT Freight & Analytics is an award-winning employer of choice and a next-generation SaaS technology company that has been at the leading edge of freight and logistics innovation for nearly five decades. Founded in 1978, DAT operates the largest freight marketplace in North America — processing 250 million+ load posts annually and maintaining one of the largest repositories of freight market transaction data in the world. On a defined path to $1 billion in revenue, DAT deploys a suite of software solutions, machine learning models, and intelligent automation tools that help brokers, carriers, and shippers price freight accurately, source capacity, reduce risk, and operate more efficiently. With nearly 700 teammates across offices in Denver, CO; Portland, OR; Seattle, WA; Springfield, MO; Toronto, ON; and Bangalore, India, DAT combines the credibility of a multi-decade market leader with the drive of a company that is not done disrupting the industry it helped build. For more information, visit www.DAT.com

Application Deadline: 10/1/2026

The Opportunity

We're hiring a Senior Associate to help redefine how BizOps gets done at DAT. This hybrid role sits at the intersection of strategy, business intelligence, and applied AI: you'll deliver the insights leaders rely on for strategic decisions, while designing and deploying AI agents that scale and extend our analytics capabilities.

You'll partner with stakeholders across the business to surface high-value problems, develop and report on KPIs that inform target priorities and team performance, and build agentic workflows that turn recurring tasks into self-service tools. With each analysis, you'll ask the natural follow-up: what can an agent do to complement this next time?

This is a high-impact IC role with meaningful visibility at the leadership level. Agents are rapidly transforming internal BizOps functions, and you'll shape how we incorporate them into ours.

What You’ll Do

Develop and operate agentic solutions to traditional business intelligence responsibilities:


Strategic Oversight: Support leadership in developing and executing business strategies. Assist with setting organizational goals, tracking progress, and ensuring alignment across departments.
KPI development & ownership: Develop and own the key performance indicators that leadership uses to measure business health, ensuring metrics stay aligned with evolving strategic priorities.
Strategic & ad-hoc analysis: Partner with stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Product, and Marketing to scope analytical questions, deliver deep-dive insights, and translate findings into clear recommendations that drive business decisions.
BI development & reporting: Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and data models that make key business metrics accessible, accurate, and trustworthy across the organization.
Agent design & deployment: Design, prototype, and deploy AI agents that augment workflows, including agents that monitor metrics for anomalies, generate narrative summaries, answer ad-hoc data questions, and automate routine reporting cycles.
Performance monitoring & iteration: Track how deployed agents and dashboards perform in the wild, gather feedback from end users, and continuously refine outputs to improve accuracy, usefulness, and adoption over time.
Automation opportunity identification: Spot repetitive analytical tasks across the organization and evaluate which are best suited for agentic automation versus traditional BI tooling, balancing impact, complexity, and risk.
Data quality & integrity: Partner with Data Engineering to validate source data, surface inconsistencies, and ensure that both human-facing analyses and agent outputs are built on a trustworthy foundation.
Documentation & enablement: Document agent capabilities, limitations, and intended use cases so stakeholders know when to trust outputs and when to escalate or verify.


The Skills And Experience You’ll Bring


3-5 years in high-growth startups, strategy consulting, business intelligence, data analytics or specialized BizOps roles. Series A–C experience is a significant plus.
Strong SQL and Excel skills. You can independently get to the data you need and build the models behind your own reporting.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
Daily working fluency with AI tools in your day-to-day work; comfortable writing clear prompts, evaluating outputs, debugging agent behavior, and knowing when human judgment must override automation.
Growth mindset and a willingness to work hard; this will be a high-effort, high-reward type role for those excited about building business leverage with AI.


Nice to Haves:


Experience deploying AI agents or LLM-powered tools, including thinking through evaluation, monitoring, and failure modes.
Experience in logistics, fintech, marketplaces, or B2B SaaS businesses.


Why DAT?

DAT is an award winning employer of choice.

For starters, we have a hybrid work environment, but we also know what makes a great workplace. We have a time-tested and resolute set of operating values predicated on integrity, mutual respect, open communication, and executing with excellence. These values inform our strategic vision as much as any one of our products does. We’ve been an employer of choice in the Portland metropolitan area for four decades, and within one year of opening our Denver office, DAT was #26 on Built In Colorado’s 100 Best Places to Work In Colorado.

Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

As a Lunar Data Applications Engineer, you are responsible for building data models, crafting intuitive visuals, and providing analysis that helps Blue Origin build a road to the Moon. Within the Lunar business operations organization, we build relationships with budget owners to technical design teams that cover the design, build, and operate lifecycle. Our team accelerates program operations and strengthens the value of analytics in modern aerospace.

We are looking for someone to apply technical expertise, customer focus, and dedication to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight.

Active listening, digs into root causes, and translates pain points into actionable solutions
Demonstrates strong business acumen and understands complex program operations
Takes ownership of ambiguous problems and delivers high-quality solutions independently
Creates intuitive data visualizations that tell compelling stories and drive adoption
Writes clear documentation that enables others to understand and extend your work
Thrives in fast-paced environments where priorities shift as programs evolve

Designs and builds data models supporting Lunar program planning, tracking configuration, schedule, and technical performance across Lunar Permanence programs
Creates dashboards and key metrics used by program leadership for decision-making and business reviews
Develops automated data pipelines using Python and SQL to enable teams across engineering, supply chain, configuration management, production, and operations
Partners with budget owners and technical teams to identify analytics needs and deliver self-service reporting solutions
Leads technical data modeling efforts for cross-functional analyses spanning multiple Lunar programs
Establishes data quality standards and documentation practices that enable team scalability

Passion For Our Mission: Millions of people living and working in space!
4+ years SQL experience with either Python, and/or Spark as a plus
Demonstrable experience with GenAI tools to generate, review, and deploy code, especially data reporting tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Databricks Apps)
Experience with professional visualization tools (e.g. Databricks / Tableau / PowerBI / etc.)
Experience working with customers to gather requirements and present data solutions


Preferred Qualifications


2+ years building models and reports with Databricks (preferably with Certified Data Analyst Associate)
Experience using Git, Gitlab for code management (Branching / Merging, CI/CD, Variables, Deployment)
Experience building automated data pipelines using Python, DBSQL, and/or Spark
Experience with AWS infrastructure and tools (ECS, RDS, Lambda, etc.)
Experience with hierarchical data structures, especially with hardware bill of materials and production plans
Domain knowledge in engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and/or aerospace

The Opportunity

As a Health Data Science Consultant- Senior Associate, you will engage with clients to analyze workforce data, identify trends, and develop predictive models that drive strategic decisions and enhance employee performance. Within our Workforce Consulting practice, you will focus on leveraging data and insights to optimize workforce strategies, improve employee engagement, and drive organizational effectiveness. In this role, you will provide actionable recommendations that help clients make informed workforce decisions.

As a Senior Associate, you will build meaningful client connections and learn how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality outcomes. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will be comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, using these moments as opportunities to grow.

In this role, you will utilize a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems. You will interpret data to inform insights and recommendations, upholding professional and technical standards. This position offers a dynamic environment where you can develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving.

Responsibilities


Analyzing client workforce data to identify trends and develop predictive models
Leveraging data insights to provide actionable recommendations for workforce decisions
Developing and implementing strategies to optimize workforce and enhance employee engagement
Utilizing analytics software and tools such as Alteryx and Power BI for data visualization and reporting
Collaborating with clients to understand their human resources needs and deliver tailored solutions
Applying machine learning techniques to improve data-driven decision-making processes
Conducting complex data analysis to support organizational development and talent management initiatives
Building and maintaining client relationships to drive strategic decisions and improve performance
Guiding teams in the use of emerging technologies and innovative methodologies in workforce analytics
Interpreting data to inform insights and recommendations for enhancing organizational effectiveness


What You Must Have


At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 3 years of experience


What Sets You Apart


Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Actuarial Science, Analytics/Data Science, Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Economics, Finance, Financial Mathematics/Quantitative Finance, Government/Public Policy, Health Administration/Public Health, Human Resources/Industrial Relations, Mathematics/Statistics, Organizational Management/Behavior, Psychology/Social Psychology, Social Sciences/Humanities, Taxation

Building meaningful client relationships through effective communication

Title: Data Analyst - Power BI
Description:
Piper Companies is seeking a Data Analyst to join a mission‑driven Digital Transformation team focused on reshaping how patients and providers interact through innovative digital solutions. This role plays a key part in enabling data‑driven decision making by transforming complex data into actionable insights that drive operational efficiency, product performance, and meaningful business outcomes. This position is fully remote, with occasional travel for team‑building on client site.

Overview

In this role, you will partner with product, clinical, operational, and analytics stakeholders to understand business objectives, prepare and model data, and deliver reporting that clearly communicates progress toward key product goals. You will support the development of KPIs, build Power BI dashboards, and provide analytical insights that guide product and operational decisions. You will work under the supervision of the Sr. Director of Data & Analytics and collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Identify, define, and document key performance metrics for digital products, ensuring consistent and repeatable KPI definitions.
Clean, model, and prepare data from the enterprise data warehouse and other primary sources using SQL, Python/Pandas, and Databricks.
Develop, maintain, and optimize Power BI dashboards and visualizations that clearly communicate product performance to stakeholders.
Respond to ad‑hoc reporting requests by gathering and analyzing data to answer business and operational questions.
Communicate analytical findings through clear written summaries, presentations, and discussions with product, clinical, and operational teams.
Collaborate with data scientists and analytics staff to operationalize data workflows and support modeling efforts.
Partner with product teams to understand business needs, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide data‑driven recommendations.
Participate in departmental meetings, cross‑functional committees, and quality/service improvement initiatives.
Adhere to departmental policies, procedures, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
Perform additional duties as assigned.


Qualifications

Education & Training


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.


Experience


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis or a related field.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities


Strong data modeling and analysis skills, including experience with Databricks, Python/Pandas, and SQL.
Proficiency working with large relational databases (Microsoft SQL Server preferred).
Experience with version control tools such as GitHub or Azure DevOps.
Advanced Power BI skills, including building dashboards, visuals, and DAX measures.
Strong Excel proficiency.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights for diverse audiences.


Compensation & Benefits


Salary: $105,000 – $115,000 annually.
Work Environment: Fully remote with occasional travel for team‑building.
Comprehensive benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), PTO, holidays, and sick leave as required by law.

Cette personne a de l'expérience dans la manipulation de grands ensembles de données, souvent complexes, autant structurées que non structurées. Nous recherchons des personnes d'horizons divers ayant des compétences démontrées en résolution de problèmes et en méthodes quantitatives. Communiquer des idées et des méthodologies de manière claire et succincte, autant à un public technique que non-initié.
Participer à des projets spéciaux et autres tâches connexes selon les besoins.




Exigences

D’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes.
2+ ans d'expérience en rédaction de requêtes SQL complexes, pour transformer et extraire des données de bases de données relationnelles ou d'entrepôts de données.
Expérience en Python et/ou R afin de manipuler et analyser de grands ensembles de données.
Connaissance de techniques et de concepts statistiques.
Excellentes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale.
Bilinguisme français et anglais.
Capacité à collaborer avec les membres d’autres équipes.




La connaissance de la langue anglaise est exigée pour ce poste, car les fonctions de la personne titulaire nécessiteront des communications quotidiennes avec une clientèle majoritairement anglophone située à l'extérieur du Québec.

100% employer-paid competitive health package including Medical & Dental benefit.

Education

Description:

Under general direction of the Central Health's Analytics Quality Manager, the Senior Data Analyst is responsible for organizing, analyzing and reporting on data from large clinical, financial, and enrollment datasets. They will also assist in the design and development of data warehouses, performance dashboards and other systems that support the needs of an integrated network of physicians, safety net providers and hospitals to advance care that is patient centered and data driven. This analyst will act as an Epic subject matter expert for front/back-end Epic reporting development.

Remote = Individuals in this position may work at an approved off-site location; however, they may be required to occasionally visit an on-site location in Austin, Texas.

Essential Functions


Collect and document business requirements for reporting and analysis initiatives with customers, which includes gathering, formatting and analyzing clinical, claims, eligibility, financial and other data from various sources to develop reports and dashboards.
Serve as an Analytics and Reporting lead on assigned projects.
Perform quantitative and/or qualitative data analysis and prepare results to share with internal and external customers.
Aid in design and development of data warehouse/data mart applications.
Create and maintain reports and dashboards for multiple stakeholders including clinical, operations, finance, planning, strategy, reimbursement and other Central Health teams.
Collaborate with IT (Joint Technologies) when necessary to automate reporting and to troubleshoot data issues.
Utilize SQL or other advanced analytic tools to perform data extract, integration and query functions. Identify and troubleshoot data anomalies and irregularities.
Work closely with Epic Business Intelligence Director to identify potential solutions for various reporting needs.
Builds SlicerDicer and Reporting Workbench reports and completes Epic Radar setup for custom SQL metrics.
Prepare written and oral reports that communicate necessary information to internal and external customers.
Produce and streamline as needed ongoing monthly, quarterly and annual reports in support of CentralHealth.
Become a data subject matter expert (SME) and understand various sources and applications of Central Health data.



Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Demonstrated ability and desire to lead projects.
Advanced SQL query writing with experience working in a Microsoft SQL Server environment.
Experience developing and troubleshooting programming code (e.g. SAS, R, Python, SQL).
Uses statistics to problem solve and perform moderately complex data analysis and validation.
Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects with varying deadlines.
Complies with data confidentiality and security procedures.
Demonstrated advanced experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
Worked in a data cloud warehouse environment such as Snowflake.

Diplôme en informatique, science des données, analyse d’affaires ou dans un domaine connexe.

Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

About The Role

As a Senior Analyst in a well-funded Series C stage start-up, you will be defining our growth potential for years to come.You will be an integral part of Reserv's data team, working to develop and maintain our data model, curate the semantic layer that powers our analytics and intelligent tools, and generate the new features that unlock deeper insight into our claims. For this role, we are seeking data analysts with strong Python and SQL skills, a curiosity for how claims work and how our systems work them, the ability to communicate with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike, and the ability to both run independently and collaborate with our engineering and operations orgs. If you are ready to mold the vision for Reserv’s technology, join us on the journey.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

What You'll Do


Build and maintain dashboards that provide actionable insights for executive and functional leaders
Develop robust Python- and SQL-based reports to support a deeper understanding of the claim lifecycle and operational performance
Collaborate closely with engineering and operations teams to understand source system structures and translate them into our standardized data model
Conduct analyses to investigate performance issues, identify root causes, and make recommendations to leadership
Serve as the primary technical liaison between the data team and key internal stakeholders, ensuring analytical solutions meet real business needs
Communicate ideas and solutions through clear, concise writing and presentations
Help influence the culture, values, and processes of a growing data team
Enjoy and have fun being creative and thinking outside of the box. You will need to draw on analogous situations you’ve worked on before, but we are not traversing well-traveled roads. “Where we’re going, we don’t need roads!”


Qualifications


2–4 years of experience as an individual contributor in data analytics, business intelligence, or consulting
Strong proficiency in SQL (e.g., Postgres, BigQuery, or Snowflake) and experience working with large, structured datasets
Experience building reports or dashboards in Looker (preferred) or a similar BI tool (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Mode)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to distill complex data into clear, actionable insights
Excellent communication skills — able to summarize findings and present recommendations to senior leaders
Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
Have a strong technical skillset but also the willingness and ability to take over tasks outside your core competency


Benefits


Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!


At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

Job Summary

The Business Intelligence Data Analyst owns enterprise reporting, KPI governance, and operational performance visibility, enabling real-time insight into revenue, backlog, margin, labor utilization, and project execution metrics.

This role partners closely with Finance, Operations, Sales, and project teams to define metrics, standardize reporting, build dashboards, and surface actionable insights that improve execution and business performance.

Job Duties


Design and develop interactive dashboards, scorecards, and enterprise reports in Microsoft Power BI to provide visibility into revenue, backlog, margin, labor utilization, and project execution metrics.
Build and optimize semantic models, datasets, and scalable data models using star schema and dimensional modeling techniques.
Develop advanced calculations, measures, and business logic using DAX to support standardized KPI reporting and decision-making.
Implement and support Microsoft Fabric solutions, including Lakehouse architectures, data pipelines, and cloud-based enterprise reporting capabilities.
Create and maintain data transformation workflows using Power Query, SQL, and Fabric pipelines to integrate and prepare data from ERP, MES, CRM, financial, operational, and manufacturing systems.
Collaborate with Finance, Operations, Sales, and other business stakeholders to define KPIs, metrics, reporting requirements, and governance standards.
Establish and maintain reporting governance, data quality standards, documentation, security models, row-level security, and data access controls.
Monitor report performance, optimize query efficiency, and troubleshoot reporting, refresh, and data integration issues.
Support self-service BI initiatives through user enablement, training, and scalable reporting solutions that reduce manual effort and improve adoption.
Assist with enterprise data strategy, analytics modernization, and broader cloud data initiatives to improve operational and financial insight across the business.


Requirements

Minimum Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.
3+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analysis, enterprise reporting, or operational analytics.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Power BI, including dashboard development, semantic models, and enterprise reporting solutions.
Strong SQL skills and experience with Power Query for data extraction, transformation, and preparation.
Experience developing DAX calculations, measures, and business logic to support KPI reporting and analytics.
Understanding of scalable data modeling concepts, including star schema and dimensional modeling techniques.
Utilize AI/ML techniques and generative AI tools to enhance analytics and automate processes.
Experience integrating and validating data from ERP, MES, CRM, financial, operational, or manufacturing systems.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, data pipelines, Lakehouse concepts, or other modern cloud data platforms.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience building executive dashboards and operational scorecards in a manufacturing, project-based, or industrial environment.
Familiarity with manufacturing, supply chain, operations, finance, and sales analytics.
Working knowledge of DAX, Power Query, Python, or other data transformation and analytics tools.
Experience with Infor CloudSuite Industrial (CSI v10 multi-tenant cloud environment preferred).
Familiarity with KPI governance, master data management, and data quality best practices.
Experience with statistical analysis, forecasting, trend analysis, and predictive modeling.

100% medical premium paid for by Panelmatic for the employee-only level medical coverage

Peterbilt Motors Company

Daily activities involved in this role include sales reporting for the Peterbilt General Sales Managers, Region Sales Managers, and District Sales Managers including, but not limited to, Tableau dashboard management and general communication with the team.

Extract, clean, merge, transform and compile data from various data sources, including relational databases, flat files, NoSQL databases and unstructured data
Create and implement data visualization models and dashboards supporting data projects using MS SQL, Snowflake, Tableau and Power BI or other comparable tools

Implement various sales and sales operations initiatives by providing data architectural design and development support.
Up to 5% travel is expected for this position

Bachelor’s Degree required (quantitative field preferred)
Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science or related field is strongly desired.
7 years of related experience in a data or systems analyst role
Advanced knowledge of Excel and Access required
Knowledge of SQL and/or Snowflake required
Experience with data visualization required (Tableau and/or PowerBI)

Preferred Qualifications


ITIL Foundations Certification preferred
Proficient with Peterbilt CARS and OPS system preferred.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
Experience with Agile Methodologies a plus
Six Sigma experience a plus
Must be a highly-motivated self-starter and self-directed learner with a creative mind, high attention to detail, and a solution-oriented outlook
Ability to succeed in a multi-functional business environment and influence adoption of new ideas
Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, including active listening, problem solving when under pressure, and facilitation
Capacity to lead and work effectively with cross-functional teams
Highly self-motivated and flexible with focus on delivery


Additional Preferred Qualifications


Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to interact professionally with a diverse group of executives, managers, and subject matter experts
Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies including Scrum or Kanban
Demonstrated problem solving, facilitation, and customer service skills
Able to work effectively in a team environment with little or no supervision
Strong understanding of business process, preferably in supply chain operations
Effective presentation skills suitable for senior management
Working knowledge of application technology stack and requirements for integration into the business environment
On-call availability for business support
Experience in Manufacturing industry
Self-motivated and able to work effectively with little or no supervision
Proficient with Microsoft productivity tools, including: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Project, Azure DevOps


General Description Of All Benefits

As a U.S. PACCAR employee, you have a full range of benefit options including:


401k with up to a 5% company match
Fully funded pension plan that provides monthly benefits after retirement
Comprehensive paid time off – minimum of 10 paid vacation days (additional days are provided with additional seniority/years of service), 12 paid holidays, and sick time
Tuition reimbursement for continued education
Medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family
Flexible spending accounts (FSA) and health savings account (HSA)
Paid short-and long-term disability programs
Life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance
EAP services including wellness plans, estate planning, financial counseling and more
This position is also eligible for a holiday gift.

Title: Senior, Data Analyst - Advanced Analytics (SQL, Tableau, Business Fluency)
Description:
Position Summary...Hello there! Are you someone who thrives on solving complex problems and loves to dive deep into data? If so, we've got an exciting opportunity for you at Walmart, the world's largest retailer. We're on the hunt for a Senior Data Analyst who's ready to take on meaningful challenges and make a real impact.

What you'll do...This role is a part of the Decision Sciences, Delivery Data & Analytics. We are a BI team that will support the ecommerce transportation’s daily operations. You will help our users navigate through billions of data so they can take the best decision in a timely manner. You will be working with operations and finance and provide them with the insights they need. You will learn a lot about the business and upgrade your tech skills in this role.

You’ll make an impact from the first day if you have:


Excellent SQL Skills. Capability to manipulate data from multiple tables while keeping the data integrity (4-6 years)
Creativity with a User Experience foundation to develop impactful Tableau Dashboards (2-3 years)
Business Operations Fluency. Capability to understand and root cause a business problem. A Supply Chain background, preferably with Last Mile Delivery or Parcel Deliveries experience.
Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally


Responsibilities:


Work with large, messy, disparate datasets and conduct ad-hoc analyses to quickly inform critical business decisions. Create ETLs or processes that pull data from multiple places and centralize it in one table.
Develop data visualization to monitor and quantify the impact of changes and unique business challenges.
Engage with team members and cross-functional teams on a periodic basis and establish credibility. Analyze stakeholder needs and partner with them to share relevant information. This includes partnering with Operations, Finance and Product teams on data accuracy, completeness and latency across multiple operations and systems
Leverage scripting languages (Python preferred) to automate activities made for reporting (Screenshots, metrics prioritization and outlier recognition)
Document your processes and share your knowledge with your peers. Mentor your peers as you become a Subject Matter Expert.


Minimum Qualifications:


Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Statistics, Economics, Analytics, Mathematics, Arts, Finance or related field and 2 years' experience in data analysis, data science, statistics, or related field. Option 2: Master's degree in Business, Engineering, Statistics, Economics, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Technology or related field. Option 3: 4 years' experience in data analysis, data science, statistics, or related field.
Advanced SQL and Tableau user


Preferred


Advanced experience with SQL and Tableau
Experience with ecommerce operations or parcel carrier operations
Experience with Python or other scripting language.
Experience with data manipulation tools such as Knime, Alteryx, R, Tableau Prep etc.


At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. If you’re good at what you do, you can work anywhere. If you’re the best at what you do, come work for Doma Technology.

About Us 

Doma Technology LLC offers solutions for lenders, real estate professionals, title agents, and homeowners that make closings vastly simpler and more efficient, reducing cost and increasing customer satisfaction.

Our Values


Obsessively Entrepreneurial - We encourage calculated risk-taking, and we know that some of our best learning happens by making mistakes along the way.
People First - We communicate with honesty and respect to our customers, colleagues, and partners.
Better Together - We believe diversity, equity and inclusion creates value through the differences in our backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
Act with Integrity - We hold ourselves to the highest ethical standards in all of our business practices.


Doma is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to own and evolve Looker, the business intelligence platform our Operations teams rely on for real-time, day-to-day reporting — SLAs, exception management, escalations, hands-on time reporting, turnaround times, vendor management, and more. You’ll be the primary point of contact for Looker across the company: owning the connectivity between Snowflake and our other source data and Looker end-to-end, building and maintaining the dashboards that keep Operations running, safeguarding data quality and provenance, and partnering with Finance, Data Science, and other business units on their reporting needs. We’re also looking for someone excited about what comes next — ideally with experience building or working hands-on with AI/agentic reporting tools — to help us build an agentic reporting layer on that same underlying data so business users can self-serve ad hoc questions that don't require long term dashboards.

You're fired up to:


Use your raw data analysis intuition to revolutionize a 150-year-old industry
Own, build, and maintain the Looker dashboards and data models that Operations, Finance, and Data Science depend on every day
Own the connectivity between Snowflake and other source data and Looker — the pipelines, data models, and integrations that keep our reporting layer accurate and current end-to-end
Be the primary point of contact for Looker company-wide — fielding requests, triaging issues, and setting standards for how dashboards get built
Oversee data quality and data provenance across our reporting layer
Play a key role in day-to-day operational decision-making — SLAs, exception management, escalations, hands-on time reporting, turnarounds, and vendor management — through rapid delivery of insights
Design and help build an agentic reporting layer on top of our existing data — working hands-on with AI reporting agents so business users can self-serve ad hoc requests instead of filing a ticket
Learn and leverage the ins and outs of a complex, valuable problem domain in title insurance and real estate


You definitely have:


3-5 years contributing to data analytics, business intelligence, or data science projects, ideally across a variety of professional contexts (e.g. start-ups and large companies, or consumer- and business-facing applications)
Professional experience using Looker — LookML, dashboard design, and data modeling
Ability to write complex SQL joins in your sleep
Professional experience writing code with proficiency in Python, git, and similar tools
Ability to communicate technical concepts to people throughout the company, including business partners in Operations, Product, and senior leadership
Strong opinions, loosely held, about all things data


You might even have:


Ideally, hands-on experience building, configuring, or working with AI/LLM-based reporting agents or similar agentic analytics tooling — prompt design, pipeline setup, and keeping an agent grounded in accurate underlying data
Experience owning data pipelines or connectivity between a warehouse (e.g. Snowflake) and a BI tool like Looker
Experience in the domains of risk, real estate, title, and/or insurance
Experience owning data quality or governance for a BI platform at scale

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role (the role may be filled at more than one level; strong candidates earlier in their careers will also be considered)
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards

Align assessment strategy with strategic objectives and goals.

Conduct quality assurance and review of all data visualizations to ensure accuracy, usability, and adherence to existing branding and style guidelines.

Work with leadership to develop an efficient system for planning and administering surveys to minimize survey fatigue and maximize the collection of actionable data.
Other duties as assigned.

Bachelor's Degree.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

Join Kyndryl as a Data Analyst where you will unlock the power of data to drive strategic decisions and shape the future of our business. As a key member of our team, you will harness your expertise in basic statistics, business fundamentals, and communication to uncover valuable insights and transform raw data into rigorous visualizations and compelling stories.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work closely with our customers as part of a top-notch team. You will dive deep into vast IT datasets, unraveling the mysteries hidden within, and discovering trends and patterns that will revolutionize our customers' understanding of their own landscapes. Armed with your advanced analytical skills, you will draw compelling conclusions and develop data-driven insights that will directly impact their decision-making processes.

Your role goes beyond traditional data analysis. You will be a trusted advisor, utilizing your domain expertise, critical thinking, and consulting skills to unravel complex business problems and translate them into innovative solutions. Your proficiency in cutting-edge software tools and technologies will empower you to gather, explore, and prepare data – ensuring it is primed for analysis, business intelligence, and insightful visualizations.

Collaboration will be at the heart of your work. As a Data Analyst at Kyndryl, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, pooling together your collective expertise to gather, structure, organize, and clean data. Together, we will ensure the data is in its finest form, ready to deliver actionable insights.

Your unique ability to communicate and empathize with stakeholders will be invaluable. By understanding the business objectives and success criteria of each project, you will align your data analysis efforts seamlessly with our overarching goals. With your mastery of business valuation, decision-making, project scoping, and storytelling, you will transform data into meaningful narratives that drive real-world impact.

At Kyndryl, we believe that data holds immense potential, and we are committed to helping you unlock that potential. You will have access to vast repositories of data, empowering you to delve deep to determine root causes of defects and variation. By gaining a comprehensive understanding of the data and its specific purpose, you will be at the forefront of driving innovation and making a difference.

If you are ready to unleash your analytical ability, collaborate with industry experts, and shape the future of data-driven decision making, then join us as a Data Analyst at Kyndryl. Together, we will harness the power of data to redefine what is possible and create a future filled with limitless possibilities.

Your Future at Kyndryl

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

This position is for a government client and we can only hire US citizens or full green card holders.

Required Skills, Experience and Circumstances:


Minimum of 5+ years of data analysis experience
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills
Communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex data insights to both technical and non-technical audiences
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, while maintaining a high level of attention to detail


Preferred Skills and Experience:


Degree in a quantitative discipline, such as industrial engineering, finance, or economics
Knowledge of data analysis tools and programming languages (e.g. Looker, Power BI, QuickSight, BigQuery, Azure Synapse, Python, R, or SQL)
Professional certification, e.g., ASQ Six Sigma
Cloud platform certification, e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics – Specialty, Google Cloud Looker Business Analyst, or Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate


Compensation:

The compensation range for the position in the U.S. is $77,040 to $146,640 based on a full-time schedule. Your actual compensation may vary depending on your geography, job-related skills and experience. For part time roles, the compensation will be adjusted appropriately. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement.

There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations:

California (San Francisco Bay Area): $92,520 to $175,800

California (All Other): $84,840 to $161,160

Colorado: $77,040 to $146,640

Massachusetts: $77,040 to $161,160

New York City: $92,520 to $175,800

Washington: $84,840 to $161,160

Washington DC: $84,840 to $161,160

This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off. Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program.

Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Being You

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets

Strong communication and presentation skills

Mine, process, and summarize data; Manage the quality assurance of data scraping, query databases for stakeholder requests, and triage data issues for timely resolutions; Analyze large datasets, draw valid inferences and prepare insights in narrative or visual forms, including dashboards; Set up and maintain data processes and new analytics capabilities; Produce and track key performance indicators; Ability to formulate functional and technical requirements from business problems; Program management of key tasks and resources to achieve cost and schedule

Experience developing and utilizing pivot tables and databases to obtain data and develop reports

Experience with SAP preferred

Experience developing affirmative work relationships in order to interface with all levels of personnel in a positive manner

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights

We strengthen connections between education and industry, expand adoption of Autodesk technology, and support workforce readiness in an increasingly AI-enabled world.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the Business Operations and Analytics team. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Strategy, and other teams to understand business needs, scope analytical work, and turn customer and business data into clear insights and practical recommendations.

This role focuses on delivering insights and decision support while collaborating with data and technology teams as needed. You will work hands-on with SQL, Python, Snowflake, and business intelligence tools, and use approved AI tools to improve the speed and quality of analysis, coding, synthesis, and communication.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals, clarify analytical needs, and translate broad questions into focused analyses, metrics, and deliverables
  • Analyze customer behavior, product usage, engagement, retention, marketing performance, and operational outcomes
  • Use SQL, Python, Snowflake, visualization tools, and appropriate analytical methods to answer business questions
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and reusable analyses that support decision-making
  • Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations
  • Communicate insights through visualizations, written narratives, presentations, and discussions tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences
  • Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
  • Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
  • Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
  • Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
  • Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
  • Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
  • Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
  • Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
  • Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance

The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

You are hands-on with analytical tools and use AI as a standard part of getting work done. You understand that AI can improve speed and quality, while judgment, validation, and clear communication remain your responsibility.

Description:
Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform—where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.

Powered by LOIS, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.

Role Overview
The Principal Data Analyst will play a key role in executing Filevine’s data and analytics initiatives. Reporting directly to executive leadership, this individual will manage daily analytics operations, deliver corporate metrics, and produce actionable insights to support operational excellence and strategic decision-making across the organization. This position requires a balance of strong technical proficiency, business acumen, and solid communication skills.

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on analytical practitioner who can design and deliver high-quality analyses while engaging confidently with executive stakeholders.

Responsibilities:


Work closely with the CEO on ad-hoc or other impromptu projects, providing rapid analytical support and insights.
Lead daily operations for the corporate analytics function, overseeing the development and delivery of executive-level dashboards, KPIs, and routine reporting.
Partner with functional leaders to identify and interpret key trends across product usage, customer health, financial performance, and organizational initiatives.
Conduct complex analyses that inform strategic priorities and operational decisions.
Build and maintain robust data pipelines and models within Domo, integrating data from Salesforce, Snowflake, HubSpot, the Filevine Platform, and other enterprise systems.
Ensure data integrity, consistency, and precision across all reporting outputs.
Implement frameworks for tracking key SaaS metrics and KPIs, including ARR, GRR, NRR, churn, customer engagement, and retention.
Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, translating complex data into actionable business insights.
Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Operations, Product, and Customer Success teams to align analytics outputs with organizational goals.





Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, Economics, or a related field.
4–6+ years of experience in data analytics or business intelligence, with experience leading ad-hoc projects.
Demonstrated ability to guide projects and support team development.
Expertise in SQL and hands-on experience working with large, complex data environments.
Strong proficiency with Domo or equivalent BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).
Solid understanding of Salesforce data structures and data integration practices.
Familiarity with SaaS business models and key financial metrics.
Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively present insights to senior stakeholders.
High attention to detail, with a commitment to accuracy, data governance, and analytical rigor.





Work Location Expectation: This position is based out of our San Francisco, Chicago, Salt Lake City or New York offices. Candidates residing in or near these metro areas are expected to work on a hybrid (2-3 days in-office/week) or fully onsite basis.

Cool Company Benefits:


A dynamic, rapidly growing company, focused on helping organizations thrive
Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (for full-time employees)
Competitive & Fair Pay
Maternity & paternity leave (for full-time employees)
Short & long-term disability
Opportunity to learn from a dedicated leadership team
Top-of-the-line company swag

Description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and business-focused Senior Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across our Life Insurance operations. Reporting to the Head of Lead Management, this role will be responsible for delivering insights that optimize sales performance, improve customer retention, and support new market expansion initiatives through the transfer of operational knowledge and best practices. The successful candidate will leverage analytics, automation solutions to improve business outcomes, operational efficiency, and customer experience.




Key Responsibilities




1. Sales Optimization & Growth Support (30%)

Analyze sales performance and identify opportunities to improve lead conversion, agent productivity, and overall sales effectiveness
Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reporting for key sales metrics
Support forecasting, capacity planning, and sales strategy initiatives
Provide actionable insights to support the continued growth of the sales organization
Identify opportunities to automate reporting and business process




2. Care & Support Analytics (Post-Sales & Retention) (50%)

Analyze customer and policyholder behavior to identify drivers of retention, persistency, and customer satisfaction.
Monitor and report on key post-sales metrics, including retention, service levels, and customer experience.
Partner with Care & Support teams to identify operational improvement opportunities.
Support the development and measurement of customer retention initiatives.
Deliver insights that improve customer lifetime value and operational effectiveness.




3. New Market Expansion & Knowledge Transfer (20%)

Support the organization's expansion into new markets by documenting and transferring key operational, sales, lead management, and customer service learnings from existing business operations.
Partner with stakeholders to capture best practices, processes, reporting frameworks, and performance insights that can be leveraged in future markets.
Develop and maintain knowledge repositories, documentation, and reporting standards to support successful market launches.
Identify opportunities to replicate successful sales, lead management, and customer retention strategies across markets.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure operational readiness and consistency during market expansion initiatives.
Track and report on key readiness milestones and business learnings throughout implementation programs.




Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, Economics, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related role.
Experience in Life Insurance, Financial Services, or a regulated industry is preferred.




Technical Skills

Strong SQL skills, including Microsoft SQL Server (T-SQL).
Experience using Python for data analysis, reporting, and automation.
Proficiency with Power BI and/or Tableau.
Experience with Databricks and modern analytics tools.
Working knowledge of AI/Machine Learning concepts and predictive analytics.
Experience building automated reporting, dashboards, and ETL processes.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.




Core Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Customer-focused mindset with strong business acumen.




Benefits




That's why you can expect to be rewarded for the hard work you put in through job satisfaction, career development and the fantastic range of benefits we offer:




What's in it for you?




4 weeks vacation per year
10 paid sick days per year
Hybrid role – 3 days in office and 2 days work-from-home
100% employer paid health benefits from day 1 including $500 Healthcare Spending Account
Parental leave top-up
5% RRSP matching after 3 months of service
Learning and growth opportunities
Free weekly lunches, epic social events, and more!
