Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to work a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in our San Francisco or Toronto offices, and to translate complex healthcare and product data into clear, actionable insights that drive strategy and business impact. You are a fit if you thrive in ambiguous, cross-functional environments, own analytical deep work end to end, and enjoy influencing decisions through rigorous, well-communicated analysis.

What you’ll do:


Work cross-functionally with Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success to scope and implement trusted business metrics, proactively identify data integrity issues, and optimize operational workflows.
Translate complex datasets into clear insights with strategic recommendations that drive measurable actions and outcomes to inform business priorities.
Communicate analysis results and outcomes clearly and tailor messaging based on the audience.
Help build and evolve our analytical foundation, including event instrumentation, metric frameworks, and scalable self-serve analytics tools.
Mentor other analysts and raise the bar for data storytelling, analytical rigor, and stakeholder influence across the organization.


What we look for:


Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field such as statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent years of practical work experience.
5+ years of experience using SQL or similar big data querying languages.
5+ years of experience with a programming language such as Python or R.
5+ years of experience with applied statistical techniques, such as inferential methods, causal methods, A/B testing, or statistical modeling techniques.
Strong experience working with Salesforce or other CRM platforms, including modeling and analyzing customer, pipeline, and revenue data.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex findings from data and models into compelling insights for technical and non-technical audiences.


Bonus (Nice to have):


Advanced degree in applied mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, economics or a related field.
Experience working with sales organizations and familiarity with funnel and pipeline processes.
Strong mentorship and leadership skills, with a track record of elevating scientific standards and developing junior talent across teams.


Benefits & Perks:

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:


Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.
Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.
10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.
A home office stipend.
401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.
Paid parental leave.
A local in-person meet-up program.
Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.


(Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees)

Notice to Candidates:

To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our careers page.

Please note that EvenUp may use AI notetakers and other recording devices in the recruiting process. If you interview with us, with your consent, we may record your conversations and summarize them into notes for internal use. Recording is optional, and declining will not affect your candidacy.

EvenUp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Compensation Range: $154,907 - $246,445

Title: Specialty Pharmacy Data Analyst
Description:
About The Job

Loopback Health is hiring an innovative and team-oriented Data Analyst within the Health System Solutions team to work on a blend of clinical, economic and operational datasets to answer questions across the healthcare delivery and life sciences value chain.

The Analyst’s role will be to inquire about the nature of the question being asked, distill the question into relevant data elements to represent, the visualization and delivery format, and presentation scheme to answer the client question at hand.

The ideal candidate will have experience interfacing with internal and external client teams, problem solving with peers, and possess a strong technical aptitude with good organizational skills and a desire to learn and work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate will also have excellent problem-solving skills and exhibit strong, fact-based communication skills. At Loopback you will enjoy success, develop your professional skills, and allow your career to thrive within a fast-growing business who is expanding their team.

Duties to Include


Distill complex business and technical requirements into viable analytical solutions
Partner with subject matter experts to understand root cause patterns within data
Data mapping, transformation and normalization
Data visualization and interface/ manipulation development
Analytics platform enhancements and toolset evaluations
Troubleshooting and audit trail development


Requirements

You will thrive if you:


Exhibit a “self-starter” mindset in taking ownership over delegated project responsibilities
Quickly spot non-standard patterns in data and can follow the trail back through complex data pipelines
Enjoy rapid mastery of process dimensions around problems solved with data analytics
Are a tenacious self-learner
Are detail and results oriented


You Bring a Toolkit Of Your Past Experiences Of


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst or with Data Analytics tooling (e.g. Python, SQL, PowerBI, Tableau, etc.) in a commercial capacity
Experience working with extremely large health care datasets
Demonstrated history of integrating multiple data sets to create unique insights
Implementing and designing data curation, and data analysis frameworks
Experience working across an array of stakeholders
Effective collaboration, experienced in creating technical partnerships across teams
Learning and understanding the various data domains across the enterprise and able to communicate complex relationships between clinical and business concepts across the enterprise and various stakeholders
Effectively delivering results in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities
Documenting and testing results of your analytics efforts, engaging with QA and Delivery teams to satisfy client needs


Travel


Expected to be minimal.


This employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status (e.g., H1-B) for this position. All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

About Loopback

Loopback is a healthcare data company dedicated to improving access and outcomes for complex patients. We partner with health systems to grow and optimize specialty pharmacy performance, and we support life sciences organizations in accelerating evidence generation and expanding patient access through differentiated data and insights. Our work sits at the intersection of data, technology, and patient care, and we’re building a purpose-driven team that reflects that mission.

Founded in 2009, Loopback has been recognized by the Dallas Business Journal as one of the Best Places to Work, reflecting a culture grounded in collaboration, trust, and impact. Loopback has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies and consistently ranks among the fastest-growing companies in Dallas by the Dallas Business Journal.

The Data Analyst supports clean energy initiatives by working with large and complex datasets to create actionable insights. Combine datasets using SQL, including complex joins and data transformations
Identify data quality issues, anomalies, trends, and outliers

Experience working with data from multiple source systems
Strong attention to detail and ability to follow defined processes
Ability to identify anomalies, inconsistencies, and data quality issues
Strong written and verbal communication skills

Python

Our mission is to create a world where software is always secure and developers can innovate without fear. Trusted by thousands of organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, we are pioneers in software supply chain management, open source security, and DevSecOps.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team. In this role, you will transform complex product datasets into actionable insights, build scalable analytics infrastructure, mentor associate-level analysts, and drive data-informed product decisions.

Product Analytics & Telemetry: Analyze product usage, feature adoption, and telemetry data alongside financial metrics to optimize user experience and support product strategy.
Analytics & Data Modeling: Own the end-to-end analytics lifecycle, including data modeling, dashboard creation, and KPI development. Deliver high-accuracy analyses independently across various product initiatives.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with cross-functional business stakeholders, managing requirements and delivering precise insights on tight turnarounds.
Mentorship: Serve as a technical guide to coach and mentor the team’s cohort of associate-level analysts.
Execution Metrics: Maintain high standards for ticket throughput, speed of delivery, and on-time completion rates for analytics tasks.


What You'll Bring


Experience: 5+ years in data analysis, BI, or product analytics—specifically within a SaaS or tech company. Experience working with product telemetry/usage data is strictly required.
Location: Must be based in Canada (excluding Quebec; Ontario or Eastern time zone preferred).
Technical Stack:
Advanced SQL and Python skills.
Strong expertise in Databricks (PySpark, notebooks, data lakehouses/medallion architecture, AWS S3).
Hands-on experience with visualization tools—Looker is heavily preferred (or ability to quickly adapt from Power BI/Tableau).
Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats (JSON, DataFrames), and version control via GitHub.
Qualitative Traits: Strong curiosity, meticulous attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and clear communication skills.
Nice to Have: Knowledge of business systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Amplitude, Gainsight).

Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
Overview

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter. Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.

The Joint, Office of the Secretary of Defense, Interagency Division provides expert support services to a range of customers spanning across the Department of Defense, Federal Civilian, and international markets. JOID provides a diverse portfolio of analytical and programmatic capabilities to help our customers make informed decisions on their most challenging issues.

The Industry and Security Analysis Group (ISAG) within JOID provides analytical, technical, and program support to promote, grow, and protect the U.S. industrial base. ISAG’s support spans the Department of Defense (DOD), Department of Commerce, and other agencies to deliver critical decision support to national security leaders. Our team informs policy decisions, enables execution of comprehensive strategies and monitors and reports on the effectiveness of implementation. This enables senior leaders to execute strategies for developing and sustaining a robust industrial base that meets our nation’s strategic resource objectives. From policy to practice, we are a team of economic and national security professionals providing innovative solutions for our Nation’s most pressing security challenges.

We have an immediate need for a Sr. Data Analyst to provide onsite support out of the Pentagon and/or Mark Center in Alexandria, VA.

Responsibilities

The Sr. Data Analyst will support the newly formed Assistant Secretary of War for International Armaments Cooperation. Provide a dedicated data analytics capability in converting large volumes of data from disparate sources into decision-quality products. Manage data extraction, cleansing, and normalization from Department of War data platforms and other validated sources to support analysis and visualization for senior government leaders. Sources include Project Management Resource Tools (PMRT), Foreign Military Sales Single Tracking System (STS), International Agreements Tracking System (IATS), and Advana. Assist with streamlining ASW IAC workflows via PowerBI and PowerAutomate tools.

Qualifications

Required:


Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field
3+ years of experience developing automated data pipelines, processing complex government datasets, and building business intelligence dashboards
Expert proficiency with PowerBI, PowerAutomate, and Sharepoint systems
Active Secret clearance
Able to work fully onsite based on client needs


Desired


Active TS/SCI clearance
5+ years of experience


Pay Range Information

At SPA, we strive to deliver a robust total compensation package that will attract and retain top talent. Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. SPA provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, etc. Please note that the salary information shown below is a general guideline only. Salaries are commensurate with experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. Virginia, Pay Transparency Salary range: USD $150,000.00/Yr. - USD $170,000.00/Yr.

Description:

Essential Functions –


Design and deploy analytics and visualization solutions.
Obtain and analyze raw data from multiple disparate sources to perform core job duties and to answer questions posed by internal or external customers.
Develop reports and analytics according to requestor requirements.
Develop concise summaries of analytical exercises and clearly define recommendations and next steps

As a Data Analyst, you will join Canada Life’s Canada Operations & Business Enablement, Data Analytics and Reporting team. In this role you will support all Canada Operations and Business Enablement teams with the development, implementation, and maintenance of analytics solutions ranging from descriptive and diagnostic to predictive.

The Analyst, Data & Analytics supports decision making, monitors business performance, and provides actionable insights using analytics and statistical techniques.

In this role, you will assist in modelling, analysing, and predicting business processes. You will translate business requirements into data, reporting, and analytics projects, which you will support throughout their entire lifecycle.

What You Will Do


Translate business needs into data requirements, collect, integrate, clean, explore, model, and analyze large datasets and visualize results and present to business leaders
Build, implement and maintain data models, custom reports, and dashboards
Work with large datasets that are not consistent, clean, or fully modelled
Communicate effectively and demonstrate critical thinking and business acumen.
Define, implement, and monitor metrics and KPIs and ensure ongoing strategic alignment with short and long-term business objectives
Enable effective, efficient working relationships with business partners
Work closely with senior leaders to understand business drivers and enable them to make decisions based on data
Support projects throughout the entire analytics lifecycle
Present and communicate insights and recommendations in a visual and simplified manner

Reliability Status Security Clearance – this can only be completed with candidates who receive an offer of employment. This is a personal security status that is required as a condition of employment before an employee can gain access to Protected B information, assets or work sites as outlined by the Government of Canada website. The cost of submitting these checks will be covered by Canada Life
1-3 years of relevant experience and a bachelor’s degree in a related field of study, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification is preferred
Demonstrated experience in working with data analytics tools (SQL, Python), Databases (SQL Server), Cloud (Azure, Databricks), data visualisation tools (Power BI) with experience at creating interactive dashboards
Ability to write efficient SQL and Python queries to extract, integrate, and transform data from multiple sources, and to automate data pipelines
Proficiency in Power BI, Data Modelling, Power Query, and DAX
Experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets
Good knowledge in data analytics and statistical modelling
Strong communication and presentation skills
Proven ability to learn quickly and independently and handle multiple priorities in a challenging work environment
Experience within the Financial Services sector would be an asset


Given the size and scope of our organization, we have the flexibility for this position to be located in the following head office locations: Toronto, London, Winnipeg. This role follows a hybrid work model, with an in-office presence required three days per week.

HII-Mission Technologies is seeking a Modernization Data Analyst to support the Department of War (DoW) Chief Information Officer (CIO). Come Join our growing team today!

We are seeking a skilled Modernization Data Analyst to support DoW CIO through their IT Modernization effort. This IT transformation is foundational to building a more lethal and ready Joint Force capable of operating in contested environments, which is essential for facing and deterring current and future threats. We encourage you to apply!

This position requires a SECRET level security clearance and will work onsite in Arlington, VA.

Salary for this position will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skill set, while also considering internal equity and market competitiveness.

LEVEL 2 - $73,025 - $104,321

LEVEL 3 - $94,520 - $135,028

Essential Job Responsibilities


Analyze large, complex datasets from multiple legacy and modernized systems to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for optimization.
Collaborate with software engineers, system architects, and cybersecurity teams to ensure data integrity and accessibility across modernization efforts.
Translate technical data findings into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support data integration activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with Department of War (DoW) data governance standards.
Contribute to the development of data quality metrics and automated validation processes.


Minimum Qualifications


LEVEL 2 - 3 years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 1 year relevant experience with Masters in related field.

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings in a clear, concise manner.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Collaborative team player willing and eager to learn.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a structured environment.
Clearance: A SECRET level security clearance is required.


Preferred Requirements


TS/SCI is preferred.


Physical Requirements


May require working in an office, industrial, shipboard, or laboratory environment. Capable of climbing ladders and tolerating confined spaces and extreme temperature variances.

Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. This empowers enterprises to create and maintain secure, quality, and innovative software at scale.

As founders of Nexus Repository and stewards of Maven Central, the world’s largest repository of Java open-source software, we are software pioneers and our open source expertise is unmatched. We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development.

More than 2,000 organizations, including 70% of the Fortune 100 and 15 million software developers, rely on Sonatype to optimize their software supply chains.

At Sonatype, we empower developers with best in class tools to build secure, high-quality software at scale. Our mission is to create a world where software is always secure and developers can innovate without fear. Trusted by thousands of organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, we are pioneers in software supply chain management, open source security, and DevSecOps.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team. In this role, you will transform complex product datasets into actionable insights, build scalable analytics infrastructure, mentor associate-level analysts, and drive data-informed product decisions.

What You’ll Do


Product Analytics & Telemetry: Analyze product usage, feature adoption, and telemetry data alongside financial metrics to optimize user experience and support product strategy.
Analytics & Data Modeling: Own the end-to-end analytics lifecycle, including data modeling, dashboard creation, and KPI development. Deliver high-accuracy analyses independently across various product initiatives.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with cross-functional business stakeholders, managing requirements and delivering precise insights on tight turnarounds.
Mentorship: Serve as a technical guide to coach and mentor the team’s cohort of associate-level analysts.
Execution Metrics: Maintain high standards for ticket throughput, speed of delivery, and on-time completion rates for analytics tasks.


What You'll Bring


Experience: 5+ years in data analysis, BI, or product analytics—specifically within a SaaS or tech company. Experience working with product telemetry/usage data is strictly required.
Location: Must be based in Canada (excluding Quebec; Ontario or Eastern time zone preferred).
Technical Stack:
Advanced SQL and Python skills.
Strong expertise in Databricks (PySpark, notebooks, data lakehouses/medallion architecture, AWS S3).
Hands-on experience with visualization tools—Looker is heavily preferred (or ability to quickly adapt from Power BI/Tableau).
Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats (JSON, DataFrames), and version control via GitHub.
Qualitative Traits: Strong curiosity, meticulous attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and clear communication skills.
Nice to Have: Knowledge of business systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Amplitude, Gainsight).

Looking for a career that challenges you, fosters growth, and recognizes your contributions—all while keeping things fun? We’re currently seeking qualified candidates for a Data Analyst in our Fort Washington office. This position reports directly to the Analytics Manager and will be responsible for data gathering, analysis, and reporting.

Acquire data from various internal and external data sources
Create reports for internal teams/external clients

Derive and communicate data insights
Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices related to data analysis and BI

Title: Data Analyst - Servicing Operations
Description:
As a Data Analyst for Rocket Loans, you'll be a strategic partner to our leadership, collecting, analyzing, and reporting on data that drives operational excellence. You'll work closely with our Senior Data Analyst leadership to support operations, call center, and servicing reporting needs ultimately enabling our team leaders to make data-driven decisions that enhance efficiency and performance. You'll use a range of tools and methodologies, including statistics, technical expertise, and modern data platforms, to generate actionable insights and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. As a storyteller, you'll collect data from various sources to guide strategic decisions and support our transition to advanced analytics platforms.

About The Role


Identify and communicate patterns in operations and call center data in response to business needs using data manipulation, statistics, and data visualization
Create and support business intelligence tools, databases, dashboards, reports, and methods with a focus on operations/servicing metrics and call center activity
Use data to support and challenge business solutions with stakeholders, particularly operations and collections teams
Identify, document, and use exploratory data analysis to investigate assumptions around operational performance and team efficiency
Maintain strong relationships and alignment among operations stakeholders to meet reporting and analytical objectives
Define, gather, and validate data requirements; evaluate and ensure data quality standards are met
Develop and maintain KPIs and metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Support the team's transition to Sigma as our primary reporting and visualization platform
Stay proactive and strategic—identifying opportunities to improve processes and reporting before being asked
Stay informed of industry trends and best practices in operations, call center management, and data analytics


About You

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a scientific discipline, mathematics, applied statistics, information technology, or a related field
3+ years of experience using SQL or other querying languages to create and analyze data sets in a business setting
Experience creating KPIs/metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Experience creating dashboards, reports, and data visualization tools
Experience executing end-to-end data analysis projects in a business environment
Experience using data to tell stories tailored to different audiences
Working knowledge of standard statistical measures, probability theory, and both qualitative and quantitative techniques
Conceptual knowledge of software programming fundamentals


Preferred Qualifications


Domain expertise in operations/call center reporting and supporting operations teams with collections and call center activity metrics
Exceptional communication skills and ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for business leaders
Proven track record in data quality management and establishing data governance practices
Strategic, proactive mindset allowing you to identify opportunities and propose solutions rather than waiting for requests
Databricks SQL experience
Sigma experience for reporting and visualization
AI utilization experience and understanding of AI applications for use cases in business analytics
AWS experience


What You’ll Get

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put: We’ve got your back. Check out our full list of Benefits and Perks.

We have given it our best to create an experience that is best-of-breed in the personal loan industry and commit even more to continuously improving it. At Rocket Loans, you’ll build a career that helps you achieve your professional goals while helping clients get the loans they need to reach their financial goals. Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online marketplaces that match searchers and “research and compare” consumers with brands. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation’s largest media networks.

The direct measurability of digital media.
Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)
The advantages of technology.

We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel.

In this role you will become an expert on optimal performance and strategy of digital marketing campaigns. You will work with fellow analysts to analyze, conjecture, and manage investigations, product fixes, and optimizations to increase our yield and support our relationships with Media Partners.

You will be required to develop a deep understanding of our analytical tools and the automation of business processes and decision-making. You will need to leverage diverse problem solving strategies and balance multiple simultaneous efforts in a dynamic and high velocity environment.

You will be expected to delve into business problems and analyze opportunities for growth. Qui sommes-nous ?



Rejoindre NEXTON, c'est intégrer une entreprise où convergent l'esprit d'un cabinet de conseil, la créativité d'une Factory et la dynamique d'une ESN ! Grâce à notre expertise, nous accompagnons des clients grands comptes et des pure players tels que SNCF, Orange, et BNP Paribas dans leurs stratégies d'évolution et d'innovation digitale.



Fondée en 2011, NEXTON réunit aujourd'hui une équipe de plus de 450 experts spécialisés dans le digital, le design, l'agilité, le produit et le développement. Ensemble, ils créent un écosystème riche en connaissances et en compétences diversifiées.





Description du poste



NEXTON recrute un Data Analyst Power BI / GCP H/F, en CDI, à Paris !



Ton futur environnement de travail :



Tu intègres l'équipe en tant que Data Analyst pour l'un de nos clients grands comptes du secteur bancaire.



Tes missions :



Identifier, extraire et collecter des données provenant de différentes sources (bases de données, systèmes internes, API externes, etc.).
Effectuer des analyses statistiques et quantitatives pour comprendre les tendances et identifier les opportunités d'optimisation.
Créer des rapports et des dashboards interactifs à l’aide d’outils tels que Power BI afin de communiquer les résultats de manière claire et compréhensible.
Assurer la qualité des données en les nettoyant et en les structurant pour les rendre exploitables.
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes décisionnelles pour les aider à interpréter les données et prendre des décisions informées.
Automatiser les processus d’analyse et de reporting via des scripts ou des outils spécialisés
Se tenir informé des nouvelles méthodes et outils d'analyse de données pour optimiser les processus existants.







Qualifications



De formation supérieure (BAC+5), tu possèdes au moins 3 ans d'expérience en tant que Data Analyst dans un environnement Agile/SCRUM.



Tu as une excellente capacité à développer et documenter tes analyses (data sourcing, hypothèses et méthodes analytiques) dans une logique Lean & Agile.



Tu as une forte expérience en préparation de données (Big Query, PowerBI) en particulier sur une modern data stack.



Tu maîtrises les statistiques et les visualisations de données.





Informations supplémentaires



Pourquoi choisir NEXTON ?



Nous te proposons des avantages et des opportunités pour enrichir ton expérience professionnelle et personnelle tout au long de l'année :



▶ Des communautés dynamiques pour t'accompagner dans ton parcours.



▶ Des Meet Up pour développer tes compétences.



▶ Des formations pour te réinventer et progresser.



▶ Des événements sportifs et festifs pour t'épanouir.



▶ Un forfait mobilité durable pour faciliter ton quotidien et encourager la mobilité douce.



▶ Un téléphone de dernière génération pour rester connecté.



Prêt à nous rejoindre ? Rencontrons-nous !

  • Inserimento su progetti strategici presso primari clienti dei settori Banking e Insurance;
  • Ambiente strutturato e orientato all'innovazione;
  • Opportunità di crescita professionale e sviluppo di competenze su progetti ad alto valore aggiunto.

Nos équipes, issues des meilleures écoles, s'intègrent chez nos clients ou opèrent depuis notre LAB interne, véritable foyer d’innovation. En tant que Data Analyst Senior, vous occuperez un rôle stratégique au niveau de la data, de la business intelligence et de l'intelligence artificielle. Pilotage de la performance :

Définition de stratégies :

Contribuer activement à la définition des stratégies, notamment en matière de merchandising et de négociation, en fournissant des analyses et des recommandations basées sur les données.




Optimisation de l'écosystème de reporting :

Gérer et rationaliser l'ensemble des tableaux de bord existants. L'objectif est de réduire le nombre de dashboards pour aboutir à une constellation d'outils plus efficaces et pertinents.




Développement d'outils analytiques :

Concevoir et mettre en place des outils de reporting stratégiques, tels qu'un Revenue Performance Dashboard, pour offrir une vision claire et consolidée de la performance financière.




Analyse avancée assistée par l'IA :

Mener des analyses complexes et des raisonnements "au cas d'usage" en exploitant des technologies d'Intelligence Artificielle. Utiliser l'IA comme un levier pour explorer les données et formuler des hypothèses d'action.




🧩 Stack technique :

Langages : Python, SQL
Bases de données : BigQuery
Outils de Business Intelligence & Visualisation : Looker, Tableau
Formats de données : CSV, JSON, Avro
Outils de gestion projet : Jira, Confluence




🧩 Vous êtes la personne idéale si :

8 ans d'expérience en tant que Data Analyst.
Diplômé d'un master ou d'une école d'ingénieur avec une spécialisation en Data Analyse, intelligence artificielle ou data science.
Aisance relationnelle, esprit collaboratif et appétence pour l'amélioration continue.

✔️Une structure à taille humaine : Favorisant l'échange, l'autonomie et l'innovation, où votre impact est direct et visible.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About This Vacancy

You will work with diverse datasets to identify trends, monitor performance, and deliver actionable recommendations that help stakeholders achieve their objectives.

In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to collect, analyze, and visualize data, translating complex information into clear and impactful reports and dashboards.


Define data requirements, reporting needs, and analytical approaches based on business objectives and project requirements.
Perform data extraction, exploration, and analysis to identify trends, patterns, and insights that support data-driven decision making.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, KPIs, and analytical tools to monitor business performance and support operational and strategic initiatives.
Conduct data quality checks, validate analytical outputs, troubleshoot data issues, and produce clear documentation to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of reporting and analysis.


What We Expect From You


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
Previous experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, or related analytical roles.
Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python and Microsoft Excel for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis.
Hands-on experience with Business Intelligence and data visualization tools, such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, or similar platforms.
Proven experience in data analysis, KPI definition and monitoring, dashboard development, performance reporting, and business insights generation.
Experience working with large and complex datasets, ensuring data quality, consistency, and accuracy.
Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques and data modeling concepts is considered a plus.
Familiarity with data warehousing, ETL processes, and cloud-based analytics platforms is considered a plus.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
Good oral and written communication skills, both in Italian and English


What You Can Expect From Us

The position offers a permanent employment contract, and the base gross annual salary (Gross Annual Salary – RAL) will be no less than €30,000, in line with the National Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL) for Commerce – Tertiary, Distribution and Services.

TMC is committed to offering a competitive compensation package. At the end of the recruitment process, after assessing the candidate's experience, skills, and qualifications, the company may offer a final gross annual salary higher than the amount stated above.

In line with our business model, the final compensation package also includes a project profit-sharing component, an individual annual learning and development budget of €4,000 net, and an annual welfare allowance. Further details will be provided during the recruitment process, in accordance with the company's applicable policies.

TMC is an international high-tech consultancy company that brings expertise to its clients in order to support them with the realization of their technological challenges. As such, TMC is operating as an expert center at the disposition of its clients and we help them to be more competitive in an ever more global and faster-changing technological world. At TMC we believe that people are the driving force behind technological innovation. That is why we want to create the best possible conditions for tech talents to thrive in. We offer you a challenging and stimulating work environment in which you can be the director of your own career. As an Employeneur you are part of our TMC family. Next to our outstanding technical expertise, fun and engagement are meaningful parts of our culture.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Join the Future of Data & Analytics at The Ardonagh Group

The Ardonagh Analytics Lab is an exciting new operation established by The Ardonagh Group in Mullingar, Co. Westmeath. As a centre of excellence for data and analytics, the Lab delivers data-driven insights that support colleagues and clients across the globe.

With more than 12,000 colleagues operating across a diverse portfolio of insurance products and related services, Ardonagh is committed to using data to transform decision-making, enhance client outcomes, and build a deeper understanding of risk.

Our mission is simple: use data, analytics, and innovation to achieve better outcomes for every participant in the value chain. We explore vast and complex datasets, uncover hidden opportunities, model future scenarios, and help clients and insurer partners prepare for the unknown.

We're now looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join our growing Analytics Team and play a pivotal role in turning data into meaningful business insight.

The Opportunity

As a key member of the Data Analytics Team, you will work across a variety of datasets to both respond to business requests and proactively identify opportunities to improve performance across the Group.

You will bridge the gap between our Data Engineering and Data Visualisation teams, ensuring that data is transformed into valuable insights that drive decision-making, operational efficiency, and commercial success.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an analytically curious professional who enjoys solving complex business problems and influencing strategic decisions through data.

What You'll Be Doing


Translate complex data into actionable insights that inform decision-making, solve business challenges, and identify opportunities for growth and efficiency.
Partner closely with Data Engineering and Data Visualisation teams to understand available data sources and maximise their business value.
Present analytical findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities within large datasets and provide recommendations that support strategic business decisions.
Enhance automated reporting and dashboards through proactive analysis, meaningful commentary, and actionable recommendations.
Support the development and implementation of robust data governance, management, and reporting processes across the Group.
Explore and apply AI and machine learning techniques where appropriate to drive innovation and enhance business insight.
Contribute to the continued development of a world-class analytics function within the Ardonagh Analytics Lab.


What We're Looking For

Essential Experience & Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years' experience in data analysis and reporting.
Strong SQL expertise, including data querying, mining, manipulation, and segmentation.
Advanced quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to derive meaningful insights from complex datasets.
At least 2 years' experience using statistical programming languages such as Python or R.
Solid understanding of database concepts, structures, and data modelling.
Strong knowledge of Business Intelligence principles and analytical best practices.
Experience with one or more BI tools, including Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.


Desirable Experience


Experience within financial services.
Previous exposure to General Insurance is highly advantageous.
Knowledge of predictive analytics, machine learning, or AI-based analytical techniques.


About You

We're looking for someone who:


Is an experienced analytics professional capable of working independently and taking ownership of outcomes.
Brings a proactive, solutions-focused mindset and thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Has a genuine passion for transforming data into business value.
Quickly builds an understanding of business operations and technical environments.
Is a strong relationship builder who can confidently engage with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
Combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication and influencing skills.


Why Join Us?

At the Ardonagh Analytics Lab, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging, high-impact projects that influence decision-making across a global organisation. You'll join a collaborative team passionate about innovation, continuous learning, and unlocking the power of data to shape the future of insurance.

If you're excited by the opportunity to turn complex data into meaningful business outcomes and want to be part of a growing analytics centre of excellence, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of data-driven decision-making at The Ardonagh Group.

The Company

In an industry that never stands still, neither do we. The Ardonagh Group was founded in 2017 and has grown to become the UK’s largest independent insurance distribution platform and a top 20 broker globally.

Our best-in-class entrepreneurial and specialist brands span a network of 150+ locations worldwide and have a combined workforce of more than c.12,000 people. Across our portfolio, we offer a highly diversified range of insurance-related products and services across the full insurance value chain in the UK, Ireland and broader international markets.

From complex multinational corporations to individuals purchasing personal insurance policies, our understanding of the communities we serve, together with our scale and breadth, allows us to deliver a broad range of product and risk solutions to meet the needs of a rapidly evolving market.

If you approach life with a sense of adventure you might just find what you need at Ardonagh to bring your ambition to life.

Find out more about Ardonagh’s world of opportunity on LinkedIn or visit www.ardonagh.com.

(Senior) Data Analyst (m/w/d)

an unserem Standort in Dortmund und bis zu 80 % mobiles Office

Dashboards und Berichte in Power BI erstellen, pflegen und stetig verbessern
KPIs entwickeln und implementieren, die unternehmensweit als Entscheidungsgrundlage dienen
Reporting-Landschaft mitgestalten/weiterentwickeln und bestehende Strukturen eigenständig optimieren
Python für Datenanalysen nutzen, um komplexe Zusammenhänge sichtbar zu machen
Ansprechperson für Kundendashboards und interne Analysen sein
Datenanalysen durchführen, um strategische Entscheidungen zu unterstützen
Mit Fachabteilungen zusammenarbeiten, um Datenanforderungen gezielt zu ermitteln

Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Statistik, BWL oder einem verwandten Bereich
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Data Analyst, idealerweise in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Power BI, Python und SQL
Fähigkeit zur verständlichen Visualisierung komplexer Daten
Sicheres Auftreten in Kundengesprächen und Präsentationen
Hohe Eigeninitiative und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise
Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Wir bieten vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten: Wir unterstützen dich dabei, bei uns deine individuellen Ziele zu verwirklichen
Wir fördern umweltfreundliches Verhalten: Bei uns gibt es ein Cash-Back-Programm für einen grünen Arbeitsweg. Passend hierzu befindet sich unser Bürogebäude in verkehrsgünstige Lage - von der Zug- & U-Bahn Haltestelle ist das Büro fußläufig in nur zwei Minuten zu erreichen
Uns liegt deine Gesundheit am Herzen: Unser ganzheitliches Gesundheitsmanagement bietet verschiedenste Angebote in den Bereichen Ernährung, Bewegung, Psyche, Vorsorge und Arbeitsumfeld
Außerdem gibt’s bei uns: eine strukturierte, vollumfängliche Einarbeitung, sechs Wochen Jahresurlaub, Rundumversorgung mit Getränken und Obst (im Büro), einen Zuschuss zu deinen Lebensmitteleinkäufen, zahlreiche Mitarbeiterrabatte und einen Massageservice

We are looking to incorporate a Data Analyst to our team.

🤗 About us

We are an IT Consultant Group that provides services and creates digital solutions to improve the lives of citizens across Europe. Check out our website: www.altia.es/en

🚀 Our project and team

This is your opportunity to start working on international projects with a highly qualified team and applying the latest technologies.

You will join our European team, specifically the one involved in several projects for a significant European Agency.

Minimum Requirements

🧠 Required Knowledge

  • Knowledge of data analysis and manipulation using SQL, Python, or R to extract, transform, and analyse structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Qlik, Microsoft Fabric) to design interactive dashboards and reports.
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis methods and tools (e.g., SPSS, R, Python libraries) to support evidence-based insights.
  • Familiarity with spreadsheet tools, especially Microsoft Excel.
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and platforms (e.g., star/snowflake schemas, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, BigQuery) to support scalable reporting.
  • Knowledge of data preparation and transformation tools (e.g., Alteryx, Power Query, dbt) to ensure clean and reliable datasets.
  • High level of English.

✅ Main Responsibilities

  • Collect and clean data from various sources.
  • Analyse datasets to identify trends and patterns.
  • Create interactive dashboards and reports that utilize data storytelling to effectively present findings, with defined refresh cadences and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for key deliverables.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data needs.
  • Develop and maintain data dashboards and reporting tools that provide intuitive access to key metrics and insights, supported by clear documentation and update schedules.
  • Perform statistical analysis to support decision-making.
  • Ensure data accuracy and consistency through the implementation of data quality checks, validation rules, and regular reconciliation processes with source systems.

🔝 Skills:

  • Ability to analyse datasets, detect trends, and deliver evidence-based insights.
  • Skill in presenting findings with visuals and storytelling that support decisions.
  • Commitment to maintaining accuracy, consistency, and integrity in reporting.
  • Ability to resolve data issues and propose actionable improvements.
  • Competence in managing tasks and delivering insights on time.
  • Drive to explore new methods, tools, and data sources proactively.
  • Ability to interpret analytical findings to tell a compelling story that clearly prescribes business actions and drives strategic decision-making.
  • Ability to understand, speak and write English, optionally French as an additional asset.

This job offer has been drafted with impartiality and non-discrimination on the basis of gender, race, ideology or any other grounds in mind. In particular, it complies with current regulations on gender equality between women and men (Royal Decree-Law 6/2019)

Title: Senior Data Analyst H/F
Description:
👋 Bienvenue chez Felps Group, Une communauté d'experts passionnés, alliant leurs compétences pour propulser votre entreprise vers de nouveaux sommets.




Notre Expertise : Felps Group est une alliance de "Pure Players" composée de quatre Squads distinctes : Telecom, IT, Cybersécurité et Conduite du changement. Chacune de ces Squads est dirigée par un capitaine, expert dans un domaine spécifique. Ces Capitaines accompagnent les consultants tout au long de leur parcours chez Felps, les guidant dans le choix de leurs missions et de leurs formations. Notre objectif est de stimuler la croissance et le développement de nos consultants, les préparant ainsi à faire évoluer leurs carrières




🌐 Notre Approche : Le consultant occupe une place centrale dans notre modèle. Il est par conséquent au centre de toutes nos préoccupations. Le tandem qui est formé par le Capitaine de Squad et le Directeur associé permet un suivi optimal des consultants. Grâce à notre expertise, nous sommes en mesure de leur fournir un accompagnement personnalisé, approfondi et impactant.




👉🏼Chez Felps Group, nous croyons en la force de la diversité et de l'inclusion. Nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail inclusif où chaque employé se sent respecté, soutenu et encouragé à apporter sa contribution à l'entreprise




En tant que membre de notre équipe, vous ferez partie d'une culture qui célèbre la diversité sous toutes ses formes, qu'il s'agisse de l'âge, du sexe, de l'origine ethnique, de la religion, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'identité de genre, des compétences, des antécédents socio-économiques ou de toute autre caractéristique personnelle. Nous sommes fiers de notre engagement en faveur de l'égalité des chances et de l'équité. Nous encourageons tous les candidats qualifiés, y compris les personnes en situation de handicap reconnues RQTH, à postuler. Nous sommes engagés à fournir un environnement de travail inclusif et à offrir des aménagements raisonnables pour favoriser l'intégration de tous nos employés. Si vous avez des besoins spécifiques en matière d'accessibilité lors du processus de recrutement, veuillez nous en informer, et nous ferons de notre mieux pour vous accompagner




CONTEXTE DE LA MISSION:

Dans le cadre du renforcement de sa capacité analytique, notre client recherche un(e) Data Analyst Senior capable de transformer des volumes de données complexes en insights actionnables. Au-delà de la maîtrise technique, le poste requiert une forte aptitude à la communication : le ou la candidate devra vulgariser ses analyses auprès d'interlocuteurs non-techniques et accompagner les équipes métier dans leur compréhension des résultats




MISSION PRINCIPALE:

Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des pipelines de traitement de données à grande échelle via Apache Spark et Databricks
Développer des analyses exploratoires et descriptives en Python pour identifier des tendances, anomalies et opportunités
Produire des tableaux de bord et des rapports synthétiques à destination des équipes métier et de la direction
Présenter et vulgariser les résultats d'analyse à des publics variés (techniques et non-techniques)
Collaborer avec les data engineers pour garantir la qualité et la fiabilité des données
Contribuer à la définition des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) en lien avec les besoins métier
Proposer des axes d'amélioration des processus analytiques existants







PROFIL RECHERCHE:

Compétences techniques

Maîtrise avancée de Python (pandas, numpy, matplotlib, scikit-learn)
Expérience confirmée avec Apache Spark (PySpark) en environnement de production
Bonne maîtrise de la plateforme Databricks (notebooks, clusters, Delta Lake)
Solides connaissances SQL et modélisation de données
Expérience avec des outils de visualisation (Power BI, Tableau, ou équivalent)







Compétences comportementales

Excellente capacité de vulgarisation et de pédagogie auprès d'un public non-technique
Rigueur analytique et sens critique face aux données
Autonomie, proactivité et force de proposition
Bonne communication écrite et orale en français (niveau courant obligatoire)
Esprit de synthèse et aptitude à prioriser







EXPERIENCE &

FORMATION:5 ans d'expérience minimum en tant que Data Analyst dans un contexte de données à grande échelle
Expérience dans un environnement cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) appréciée
Formation supérieure : école d'ingénieurs, université (mathématiques, statistiques, informatique) ou équivalent

Title: (Senior) Data Analyst (m/f/d) - Barcelona
Description:
Location: Come and join us in Hamburg, Berlin or Barcelona!

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions helping people to move freely and cities to thrive.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d) to collaborate with our operational squads. In this role you will be able to become an expert in our business and data analysis systems and environment to allow you to champion data-driven decisions as part of the Data Operations team.

Be ready to work in a multinational, diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team of passionate analysts who strive for excellence and like to have fun. Are you ready for your next ride?

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:


Focus on analysing and presenting recommendations/process changes/new initiatives to management using insights derived from data.
Use your technical skills such as actively engaging in configuration and programming in the data environment, querying data via SQL from the data lake, automating data processes, deep dive analysis in Python and adjusting ETL tasks.
Bringing new insights and championing them using your analyses, dashboards, and good storytelling! We value ideas over hierarchy, and there's always a new path to follow if your idea is convincing and well-backed with data.
Develop monitoring tools to measure performance and help the business achieve its objectives.
Create queries to answer operational and business questions across our many operational teams to support decisions.
Communicate results in a clear and impactful manner.


TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE:


Educated to Degree Level or higher in an analytical discipline such as Engineering, Computer Science or Economics
5+ years of experience in an analytical role
You have curiosity in your essence, which motivates you to answer WHY things happened, not only scratching the surface, but aiming for well-founded actionable results
Curiosity about AI and its practical applications in analytics, experience using LLMs or AI-powered tools in a data context
Excellent technical skills including SQL knowledge, familiarity with visualisation tools (Metabase in particular is a plus) and python/R
Enthusiastic, outgoing and personable - you have the ability to think on your feet, work independently and also proactively with others to find solutions to issues
You understand how to engage and influence decision makers and have excellent communication skills
Driven - you are motivated to find solutions to problems and constantly go the extra mile
Strong communication and interpersonal skills as well as excellent written and spoken English


BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL:


Flexible working arrangements
LinkedIn Learning
Sabbatical & special leave policies
WeRoad partnership
Birthday, 24th + 31st December off
Short term EU work policy
Mobility Credit
Health Insurance
Employee assistance program


DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION:

FREE NOW is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age.

We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work.

ABOUT US:

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. Through our multi-mobility app, we feature broad options for everyone across 9 European markets and over 180 cities. Millions of passengers can access services including taxis, private hire vehicles, carsharing, car rental, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, and public transport within a single app.

In July 2025 Freenow was acquired by Lyft, a global mobility platform, which connects riders and drivers for billions of rides across North America and Europe. Together, Freenow and Lyft are creating a more caring and connected world, with transportation for everyone. We are a global, diverse, highly motivated, and collaborative team that strives for excellence and likes to have fun. Ready for your next ride?

Title: Data Analyst Confirmé (H/F)
Description:
Vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise qui place l’humain au cœur de ses préoccupations ? On vous attend chez Extia !

Société de conseil spécialisée dans les métiers de l’IT et du digital, Extia privilégie depuis sa création en 2007 une approche qui allie performance et bien-être au travail. Une vision de l’entreprise partagée aujourd’hui par plus de 2 500 Extiens en France et à l'international et récompensée par le label Great Place to Work® depuis 15 ans dont 10 ans sur le podium et 3 années consécutives à la première place du palmarès !

Nous croyons en l'égalité des chances et nous offrons à chaque candidat la possibilité de révéler son potentiel, sans distinction et de quelque nature qu'elle soit. Chez Extia, c’est « D’abord qui, ensuite quoi » alors, allons-y !

Créatif, vous avez toujours une solution inédite mais adéquate à proposer

Curieux, poser des questions est votre seconde nature

Analytique, vous avez une âme d’enquêteur et les énigmes n’ont aucun secret pour vous

Vous serez intégré(e) dans une équipe de consultants innovants et motivés, composée de Business Analysts, Data Scientists et Data Engineers spécialisés sur les problématiques Data Analytics. À ce titre, vous interviendrez de façon opérationnelle sur des missions de conseil autour des sujets de transformation Data Analytics, de retraitement et modélisation de données et de représentation visuelle de la donnée pour adresser des problématiques métiers.

Vous serez notamment en charge de :


Comprendre les problématiques métier,
Collecter et traiter les données en vue de l'analyse, incluant notamment la création de variables agrégées et complémentaires aux données brutes,
Automatiser et d’industrialiser les retraitements effectués sur les données,
Représenter les résultats dans un outil de restitution visuelle de façon ergonomique et intuitive,
Restituer les analyses au client notamment pas la création d’indicateurs pertinents pour les questions stratégiques des entreprises


Profil recherché

Diplômé d'une école d'ingénieurs ou équivalent (Bac +5), vous justifiez d’a minima 3 ans d’expérience réussis en tant que data analyst :


Vous possédez une bonne connaissance des outils et méthodologies de Data Analytics, incluant notamment des bases techniques (modèles de données, langage SQL, …) mais également méthodologiques,
Vous possédez une connaissance approfondie d'Excel et maitrisez les langages statistiques tels que R, Python ou SAS,
Une connaissance d'un logiciel ou langage dédié à la Data Visualization (Tableau, Qliksense ou Qlickview, Microsoft Power BI…) ainsi que des compétences en automatisation (VBA par exemple) seraient un plus.


Processus de recrutement


Échangez avec un ou une chargée de recrutement pour un premier contact téléphonique
Rencontrez un ou une Ingénieure d’Affaires (Business Manager) sur vos souhaits d’évolution
Approfondissez avec nos responsables et directeurs d’agence pour connaître la vision de l'agence


Selon votre profil, des tests ou entretiens techniques pourront vous être demandés. Tout au long du processus, vous pourrez échanger avec nos consultants pour en savoir + sur leur quotidien chez nous !

Les petits plus

🏠 Télétravail partiel possible 👛 100% des frais de transports en communs pris en charge, des tickets restaurant et une mutuelle haut de gamme 🎁 Un CSE avantageux et des challenges tout au long de l'année ! #greatplacetolive 📈 Des primes à hauteur des performances de l'année et de l'implication 🎉 250 événements par an pour rencontrer tes collègues et des locaux feel good 📢 Des formations, conférences et une plateforme d'e-learning avec LinkedIn pour monter en compétences #greatplacetolearn 👩‍ Des Communautés Métiers et du Mentorat pour partager son expertise et en apprendre sur de nombreux sujets #greatplacetoshare 🕹️ Une communauté de e-sport : Extia Gaming ! #greatplacetoplay 🌏 Envie d’évoluer ? Grâce à notre politique de mobilité interne, explorez de nouvelles opportunités en France ou dans l’un de nos 7 autres pays !

Title: Experienced Data Analyst (Ad-network)
Description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Voodoo Ad-Network is an autonomous product of around 30 people that carries the ambitious mission of providing ad network services. One goal is to leverage Voodoo’s first-party data to improve Voodoo’s monetisation. Moreover, the product is growing through new ventures like opening up to external inventory, reaching the external-advertisers market and social-network monetisation through BeReal’s recent acquisition. Thanks to promising results, our ambition is now to scale up the team to support growth.

The Ad Experience team owns the end-to-end quality of the ads delivered by our network, from ad rendering to data collection. It has a strong focus on viewability, tracker integrity and the diagnostic signals that feed our Machine Learning models. It’s composed of mostly senior Software Engineers, Mobile Developers, QA Engineers and Full Stack Engineers who iterate together to detect issues quickly, improve the user-side ad experience and protect the quality of the data flowing back into the product.

Role

We’re looking for an Experienced Data Analyst to join our Engineering & Data team. In this role, you will:


Work on end-to-end data projects with the Ad Experience squad to improve ad delivery quality, reduce ad-load and rendering failures, and maintain a high data quality.
Monitor SDK diagnostic events and build alerting, anomaly detection and root-cause analyses on top of the Ad Experience datasets.
Build data collection and transformation pipelines, and actionable dashboards.
Analyze large, complex data sets with billions of events representing the behaviour of mobile game players and of our ad network to investigate ad-quality regressions, attribution discrepancies and SDK rollouts.
Design solutions from scratch, iterate quickly, create POCs, and deploy to production rapidly.
Occasionally leverage Python skills and Statistics skills to support A/B tests on ad-experience changes


Profile


You possess substantial experience in analytical roles, ideally within a web or mobile company or the tech or ad tech industry.
You are highly skilled in SQL and have a proven track record of building production-ready pipelines that handle large and complex data sets.
You have solid experience in ETL development.
You have solid experience with DBT.
You have practical experience with Tableau or another standard dashboard platform, and can create dashboards that are shared company-wide, facilitating data-driven decision-making across departments.
Advanced knowledge of statistical tools and models will be considered a significant advantage.
Development skills, particularly in Python, will be considered a significant advantage
You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and are able to balance the tradeoff between time-consuming development and rapid results.
You have a solid problem solving mindset as well as a great track record demonstrating ownership and ability to come up with innovative ideas.
A BA/B.Sc degree in Statistics, Math, Engineering, Economy, or other quantitative fields is mandatory for this role.


Our Stack


DBT; Tableau; SQL; Athena; Spark; Python


Benefits


Competitive salary based on experience
Swile Lunch voucher
Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)
Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family
Wellness activities in our Paris office
Remote Fridays

Title: Data Analyst H/F
Description:
Le Poste

En tant que Data Analyst rattaché(e) au Pôle Pilotage commercial de la Direction de la Distribution, vous contribuez à la fiabilisation, la sécurisation et le traitement des données en assurant la consolidation des objectifs commerciaux.

Vous participez également à la production d'analyses et à la valorisation des données au travers d'outils de reporting et de visualisation destinés à accompagner le pilotage de l'activité.

Vos Missions Principales

Vous participez à la consolidation et à la mise à disposition des objectifs commerciaux afin de garantir un pilotage fiable de l’activité :


Vous consolidez les données relatives aux objectifs commerciaux et assurez leur déclinaison à l’ensemble des niveaux de l’organisation (territoires, directions, entités, équipes, collaborateurs).
Vous contrôlez la cohérence et la fiabilité des données utilisées dans le cadre des campagnes annuelles de fixation des objectifs.
Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes métiers afin de recueillir, challenger et intégrer les évolutions nécessaires au pilotage commercial.
Vous transformez et valorisez les données issues de différentes sources (notamment Excel) afin d’alimenter les outils de reporting et les tableaux de bord Power BI.
Vous analysez les indicateurs commerciaux pour contribuer à la prise de décision et à l’amélioration de la performance.


Selon les besoins de l’équipe et les demandes entrantes, vous intervenez ponctuellement sur les requêtages et traitements de données nécessaires à la production des indicateurs (maintenance corrective, évolution et création de tableaux de bord, accompagnement des utilisateurs et traitement des anomalies).

Expérience Souhaitée


Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation Bac+3 à Bac+5 en Statistiques, Informatique Décisionnelle, Data ou en Contrôle de Gestion.
Votre expérience en consolidation annuelle des données dans un environnement orienté Contrôle de Gestion serait un plus à votre candidature.


Qualités personnelles :


Vous appréciez travailler avec des équipes métiers pluridisciplinaires.
Organisé(e) et rigoureux(se), vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos capacités d'analyse et de synthèse.
Vous êtes autonome dans la conduite de vos missions et force de proposition.


Outils Informatiques


Vous maitrisez impérativement les modèles décisionnels, le langage SQL et un outil de data visualisation (idéalement Power BI).
Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils digitaux et bureautiques.
Vous serez formé(e) aux logiciels et aux processus internes d’Harmonie Mutuelle.


Nos Avantages


Accord d’intéressement
Télétravail jusqu'à 3 jours par semaine (à partir de 6 mois d'ancienneté)
22,5 jours de RTT par an
Carte déjeuner à 9,50 € (60 % pris en charge par l’employeur) et avantages CSE (enveloppes loisirs, culture, avantages vacances…)
Forfait mobilité durable : jusqu’à 400 € par an (cumulable avec le remboursement de l’abonnement aux transports en commun, dans la limite de 600 euros au total)
Contrat collectif santé et prévoyance
Plan d’épargne entreprise, plan d’épargne retraite et compte épargne temps
Formation : un parcours complet avec une plateforme d’apprentissage en ligne
2 jours d'engagement solidaire par an au profit d’associations


Le processus de recrutement :


Evaluation de votre CV par le recruteur
Entretien téléphonique avec le recruteur
Entretien avec le recruteur et avec votre futur manager
Test de personnalité suivi d’un débrief avec le recruteur


Chez Harmonie Mutuelle, votre métier contribue à une ambition collective : agir sur la santé de tous et prendre soin de chacun !


Nous sommes une entreprise mutualiste à mission et notre engagement est concret, porté par des actions de prévention, de conseil, d'accompagnement et de solidarité qui ont un vrai impact sur la vie de nos adhérents.
Nous encourageons les parcours singuliers : vous pouvez apprendre, évoluer, changer de métier ou de région grâce à la mobilité interne au sein du Groupe Vyv. L'important, c'est que votre trajectoire vous ressemble.
Nous savons que la diversité et l'inclusion sont une force, c'est pourquoi nous cultivons les différences et soutenons chaque individu. Nous luttons activement contre les discriminations et accompagnons, par exemple, nos salariés dans les moments de fragilité (maladies chroniques, aidance…). Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.
Au quotidien, vous évoluez dans un environnement de travail fondé sur la confiance, porté par un management qui valorise l'autonomie, l'écoute et le droit à l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle.
Nous faisons de l'innovation et des usages numériques un levier majeur de transformation de nos métiers au service de nos adhérents. Qu'il s'agisse de projets data et IA, de nouveaux usages digitaux ou de parcours clients repensés grâce à la tech, vous participez à notre transformation, au bénéfice de la santé de tous.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (m/w/d)
Description:
Spannend, aufstrebend und verdammt schnell – wir sind flaschenpost!

Wir liefern den Wocheneinkauf innerhalb von 120 Minuten zu unseren Kund:innen.

Gemeinsam mit über 20.000 Kolleg:innen schaffen wir es, eine komplette Branche neu zu erfinden. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2016 sind wir mittlerweile als Sofortlieferdienst für Getränke und Lebensmittel in nahezu allen Metropolregionen Deutschlands vertreten.

Seit 2020 ist die flaschenpost Teil der Oetker-Gruppe.




Senior Data Analyst (m/w/d)




Um unsere Mission zu erfüllen, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Senior Data Analyst (m/w/d) für den Bereich Operative Logistik. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für unternehmensweite KPI- und Monitoring Systeme, die täglich vom Senior Management und operativen Stakeholdern genutzt werden und gestaltest die datengetriebene Entscheidungskultur in der operativen Logistik aktiv mit. Du bist nah an den Prozessen und arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen zusammen.




Dein Liefergebiet:

Du übernimmst End-to-End-Verantwortung für unternehmensweite KPI- und Steuerungsframeworks, von der Konzeption über die technische Umsetzung bis zum Rollout
Als Business Partner:in für den Bereich Operative Logistik strukturierst, analysierst und visualisierst du komplexe Logistikdaten und schaffst so belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen für die strategische und operative Steuerung der mehr als 30 Logistikstandorte
Du übernimmst das Stakeholder-Management auf Senior-Management-Ebene und bist gleichzeitig operativer Sparringspartner für die Standorte vor Ort als Brücke zwischen Daten und operativer Realität
Du bewertest die Wirkung von Optimierungsmaßnahmen, leitest Handlungsempfehlungen ab und stellst sicher, dass Verbesserungen nachhaltig im Tagesgeschäft verankert werden
Du verantwortest die Qualität, Konsistenz und Weiterentwicklung unserer Reporting-Strukturen und sorgst für Transparenz in allen relevanten KPIs
Du treibst den Aufbau neuer Dashboards, Automatisierungen und Reporting-Logiken voran und unterstützt Teams dabei, datengetrieben zu arbeiten




Das hast du im Sortiment:

Im Data-Analytics-Umfeld hast du bereits mehrjährige relevante Erfahrung erworben, idealerweise in Logistik oder Operations
Typischerweise hast du ein Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, Logistik oder Data Science erfolgreich abgeschlossen
Du hast bereits eigenständig unternehmensweite Steuerungsinstrumente konzipiert und umgesetzt, die von Führungskräften für operative und strategische Entscheidungen genutzt werden
Du bist stark und hoch effektiv in SQL, Power BI und Low-Code-Tools. Du hebst dich durch gute Kenntnisse in Databricks, Cloud-Technologien und Python hervor und nutzt KI-Tools gezielt dort, wo sie deine Arbeit wirklich voranbringen
Du kannst komplexe Analysen klar und verständlich kommunizieren – ob im Dashboard oder im Gespräch mit Stakeholdern
Du erkennst Zusammenhänge zwischen Daten und Prozessen schnell, entwickelst eigenverantwortlich und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch praxisnahe Lösungen und setzt damit messbare Impulse für die Zukunft der flaschenpost
Du sprichst gut Deutsch und bringst idealerweise gute Englischkenntnisse mit

Work-Life-Balance – Gestalte deinen Arbeitstag flexibel und genieße die Freiheit des mobilen Arbeitens
Job-Ticket & Business-Bike – Damit nicht nur deine Arbeitszeit, sondern auch dein Arbeitsweg flexibel bleibt
Start-up-Features – Freigetränke, Kicker und Tischtennis sorgen für den nötigen Ausgleich

Modernste Technik – Wir legen großen Wert auf Fortschritt und Innovation
Team- und Networking-Events – Halte dich fit und lerne deine Kolleg:innen beim Betriebssport, Spieleabend oder Stammtisch besser kennen

Du bist nah an den Prozessen und arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen zusammen.


Dein Liefergebiet:

  • Du übernimmst End-to-End-Verantwortung für unternehmensweite KPI- und Steuerungsframeworks, von der Konzeption über die technische Umsetzung bis zum Rollout
  • Als Business Partner:in für den Bereich Operative Logistik strukturierst, analysierst und visualisierst du komplexe Logistikdaten und schaffst so belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen für die strategische und operative Steuerung der mehr als 30 Logistikstandorte
  • Du übernimmst das Stakeholder-Management auf Senior-Management-Ebene und bist gleichzeitig operativer Sparringspartner für die Standorte vor Ort als Brücke zwischen Daten und operativer Realität
  • Du bewertest die Wirkung von Optimierungsmaßnahmen, leitest Handlungsempfehlungen ab und stellst sicher, dass Verbesserungen nachhaltig im Tagesgeschäft verankert werden
  • Du verantwortest die Qualität, Konsistenz und Weiterentwicklung unserer Reporting-Strukturen und sorgst für Transparenz in allen relevanten KPIs
  • Du treibst den Aufbau neuer Dashboards, Automatisierungen und Reporting-Logiken voran und unterstützt Teams dabei, datengetrieben zu arbeiten


Das hast du im Sortiment:

  • Im Data-Analytics-Umfeld hast du bereits mehrjährige relevante Erfahrung erworben, idealerweise in Logistik oder Operations
  • Typischerweise hast du ein Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, Logistik oder Data Science erfolgreich abgeschlossen
  • Du hast bereits eigenständig unternehmensweite Steuerungsinstrumente konzipiert und umgesetzt, die von Führungskräften für operative und strategische Entscheidungen genutzt werden
  • Du bist stark und hoch effektiv in SQL, Power BI und Low-Code-Tools. Du hebst dich durch gute Kenntnisse in Databricks, Cloud-Technologien und Python hervor und nutzt KI-Tools gezielt dort, wo sie deine Arbeit wirklich voranbringen
  • Du kannst komplexe Analysen klar und verständlich kommunizieren – ob im Dashboard oder im Gespräch mit Stakeholdern
  • Du erkennst Zusammenhänge zwischen Daten und Prozessen schnell, entwickelst eigenverantwortlich und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch praxisnahe Lösungen und setzt damit messbare Impulse für die Zukunft der flaschenpost
  • Du sprichst gut Deutsch und bringst idealerweise gute Englischkenntnisse mit

  • Job-Ticket & Business-Bike – Damit nicht nur deine Arbeitszeit, sondern auch dein Arbeitsweg flexibel bleibt
  • Start-up-Features – Freigetränke, Kicker und Tischtennis sorgen für den nötigen Ausgleich
  • flaschenpost Learning – Stelle deine persönliche Learning Journey zusammen und erweitere dein Know-how durch vielfältige und innovative Trainings
  • Buddy-Programm – Dein flaschenpost-Buddy steht dir während der Einarbeitung mit Rat und Tat zur Seite
  • Modernste Technik – Wir legen großen Wert auf Fortschritt und Innovation
  • Team- und Networking-Events – Halte dich fit und lerne deine Kolleg:innen beim Betriebssport, Spieleabend oder Stammtisch besser kennen
  • Corporate Benefits – Egal ob Shopping oder Sport – Profitiere von Rabatten und Angeboten in Online-Shops, Fitnessstudios sowie exklusiven Konditionen bei Hansefit und Urban Sports Club
  • Social Responsibility – Blutspenden während der Arbeitszeit und damit Leben retten
