Title: Senior Data Analyst (Hybrid)
Description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager & Data Analyst to support grants management operations and reporting across Beth Israel Lahey Health (BILH). The Senior Project Manager & Data Analyst will serve as a liaison between grants management stakeholders, technical teams, and system business analysts ensuring the accuracy and integrity of data within the grants management system and related applications. This role will manage data elements, system interactions, and reporting requirements while developing dashboards, management reports, and analytics for leadership and other stakeholders. The position will define and oversee the reporting pipeline for the various grants operations groups, including the selection, validation, and integration of data elements from the grants management system into the enterprise data warehouse to support consistent reporting and analytics. The role will collaborate closely with Grants Administration, Finance, Compliance, Information Systems, and other ancillary groups to support informed decision-making, process improvement, and the effective use of grants management and compliance data. Successful candidates will have demonstrated experience with enterprise data lake queries (like SnowFlake), familiarily with ELT processes, report and dashboard design, and ad hoc reporting using SQL tools and PowerBI.

Leverages software applications to design solutions, performs detailed data mapping and analysis and reviews all data for accuracy and reasonableness prior to distribution. Produces business, research or clinical intelligence.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:


Manages one or more complex data projects. Utilizes hospital systems and database applications to update and analyze data. Prepares and distributes various reports to key stakeholders. Meets with departmental leadership to review reports or requests for data.
Maintains integrity and quality of data and assures data conformity meets operational requirements and goals. Acts as a central resource and integral member of data collection team. Assists in planning, establishing and monitoring criteria for data collection. Trains department staff on data acquisition methods. Extracts data from multiple sources. Audits and resolves all issues.
Ensures application access is in compliance with all regulatory and medical center practices. Acts as gatekeeper for application. Sets and defines user access and determines level of access. Reports all security risks to the application.
Collaborates with IS to obtain and maintain applications used for data collection and reporting. Recommends tools, upgrades and alternatives. Assists in the development of application security and back-up plans. Coordinates interface solution with multiple applications.
Designs and develops reporting and analysis tools. Interprets data and refines analysis. Prepares and presents comprehensive reports. Develops forms, tables and other data tools in the applications that capture, report and consolidate data. Provides application data collection, analytics and reporting expertise. Completes analytics in a timely and efficient manner.
Prepares weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports/dashboards and/or data submissions department.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Allied Health, or related field.
3-5 years related work experience required.
1-3 years of multiple application maintenance with relational databases.
Advanced technical computer skills as required for technical support specific to functional area and related systems.


Preferred Qualifications


Application Certification for one of the applications used in the department.


Competencies

Written Communications:

Ability to summarize and communicate in English moderately complex information in varied written formats to internal and external customers.

Oral Communications

Ability to comprehend and communicate complex verbal information in English to medical center staff, patients, families and external customers.

Knowledge

Ability to demonstrate in-depth knowledge of concepts, practices and policies with the ability to use them in complex varied situations.

Teamwork

Ability to act as a team leader for small projects or work groups, creating a collaborative and respectful team environment and improving workflows. Results may impact the operations of one or more departments.

Customer Service

Ability to provide a high level of customer service to patients, visitors, staff and external customers in a professional, service-oriented, respectful manner using skills in active listening and problem solving. Ability to remain calm in stressful situations.

Physical Nature Of The Job

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally in carrying, lifting, pushing, pulling objects. Sitting most of the time, with walking and standing required only occasionally.

$74,880.00 USD - $124,800.00 USD

Title: Associate Data Analyst
Description:
At MarketOnce, we empower businesses with the insights and strategies they need to excel in today's dynamic market. With a strong foundation in market research, we offer innovative solutions in research, software, consulting, advertising, and marketing to corporate, private equity firms, and other organizations seeking to achieve their goals.

Our team is distinguished by their client-centric approach—treating each client's business with the dedication and care as if it were their own. This commitment enables us to deliver personalized service and achieve the highest standards of success and innovation in everything we do. Together, our family of companies, including MarketOnce, ROI Rocket, and eAccountable, work towards delivering unparalleled solutions. Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, our global team collaborates from locations across the US and Europe.

We value curiosity, creativity, collaboration, and expertise, continuously striving to push boundaries and exceed our clients' expectations. Join us to be part of a culture that drives meaningful results.

About The Opportunity

We are seeking a data analyst with a minimum of three years’ experience to clean, structure and process data from primary market research. An understanding of quantitative marketing research techniques, tools, processes, and procedures is preferred. Experience in primary market research is required. You must have strong interpersonal and organizational skills and be detail-oriented, flexible and above all, collaborative. The range of duties includes enforcing data quality control protocols, cleaning and structuring data sets, generating data cross tabulations and conducting a variety of analytical procedures.

In this role, you will be working closely with the Sr. Director of Custom Research, various Research Managers, the Director of Marketing Sciences, fellow Data Analysts and various Publishing department personnel.

What You'll Do


Clean and structure complex data sets in SPSS/alternate platforms, including AI-based apps
Analyze/interpret results using common statistical techniques in SPSS and other programs as assigned
Produce client-friendly data cross-tabulations in WinCross, JMP and alternate platforms, including our in-house survey platform, MarketOnce
Perform various quality assurance tasks, including QA on in-progress surveys
Develop and maintain databases/data systems
Develop new process improvements as necessary


What We’re Looking For


3+ years of relevant experience as a data analyst/data processor with a track record of high performance
Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to plan, prioritize, manage, and effectively deliver on multiple projects simultaneously with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment
Understanding of market research processes highly desired
Strong knowledge of and experience with statistical packages for analyzing large datasets, specifically, SPSS, R, WinCross and/or Excel
Knowledge of Python, Javascript and/or XML helpful but not required provided you can demonstrate an understanding of survey logic and the potential to acquire the necessary expertise
Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy
BS or MS in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management or Statistics
Superior customer focus, and willingness to work evenings and weekends if needed to support our clients
A can-do, positive and collaborative attitude, with a willingness to support the development of team members across the organization


What We Offer


Competitive base salary: $72,000-$90,000/year
Flexible vacation policy – take the time you need to recharge
Comprehensive health, vision & dental insurance
401k with company contribution
Beautiful downtown Denver office with company-paid commuter benefits (parking or RTD/MBTA Pass)
Opportunity for career progression with plenty of room for personal growth


What To Expect


1st Round: 30-45 minute interview with the Recruiter
2nd Round: 60-minute interview with the Hiring Manager
3rd Round: 2 hours of onsite interviews with the Hiring Team


Please note that we are fully onsite work environment, and require daily presence at our LoDo/Union Station (Denver) or Back Bay (Boston) office. We are not considering remote, hybrid, or out-of-area candidates, and do not work with outside recruiting agencies.

MarketOnce will accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis.

MarketOnce is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe in creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We are committed to hiring individuals based on their skills and qualifications, regardless of race, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic. We welcome and encourage applications from all backgrounds.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Title: Data Analyst – Banking & Financial Services

Company: Aaratech Inc.

Employment Type: Full-Time, W2 (deployed to client projects)

Experience: 3–4 years

Compensation: $70,000 – $80,000 per year

Work Mode: On-Site / Hybrid

Work Authorization

At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Why This Role?

Banks run on data — and analysts who understand both the numbers and the regulations behind them are among the most sought-after in the market. Sharpen your skills in risk, fraud, and regulatory analytics, the specialties that command premium pay across financial services.

Job Summary

Aaratech Inc. is seeking a Data Analyst – Banking & Financial Services to turn transaction, credit, and operational data into insight. You will build risk and performance reporting, support fraud and compliance analytics, and deliver findings that drive strategic decisions in a regulated environment.

Key Responsibilities

Gather, validate, and analyze banking datasets — transactions, credit, deposits, loans, and customer data — using SQL and Python.
Design and maintain dashboards in Power BI or Tableau for financial performance, portfolio risk, and KPI monitoring.
Support fraud detection, AML/KYC transaction monitoring, and credit-risk analytics.
Prepare data for regulatory and compliance reporting (BSA/AML, CECL, stress testing, call reports).
Perform trend, variance, and root-cause analysis on financial and operational metrics.
Ensure data accuracy, lineage, and governance across reporting platforms.
Present analytical findings and recommendations to business and risk stakeholders.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, or a related field.
3–4 years of experience as a Data Analyst in banking, financial services, or fintech.
Strong, hands-on SQL skills — complex joins, window functions, CTEs, and query optimization.
Proficiency with Power BI or Tableau, plus advanced Microsoft Excel (Power Query, pivot tables, advanced formulas).
Hands-on experience with financial data — transactions, credit, risk, or regulatory reporting.
Strong analytical, data-storytelling, and stakeholder-communication skills.

Tools & Technologies You Will Use

Analytics & querying: SQL (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL), Python (pandas, NumPy), SAS.
BI & visualization: Power BI (DAX, Power Query), Tableau, Excel.
Cloud & data platforms: Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Amazon Redshift, Databricks.
Domain systems: core banking platforms, payments data, AML/fraud monitoring tools (Actimize, Verafin exposure a plus).

Preferred Skills

Knowledge of AML/KYC, fraud analytics, credit risk modeling, Basel or CECL concepts.
Experience with data governance and lineage tools (Collibra, Alation exposure a plus).
Familiarity with statistical analysis and A/B testing for product or risk decisions.
Certifications such as Microsoft PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), Tableau Desktop Specialist, or Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate are a plus.

About Aaratech Inc.

Aaratech Inc. is a technology-driven organization delivering innovative solutions across cybersecurity, data & analytics, healthcare, and enterprise domains. We are committed to helping organizations transform data into actionable insights through advanced analytics, modern technologies, and data-driven innovation.

The Senior Analytics Consultant is a senior individual contributor who serves as a strategic analytics partner to business leaders. This role transforms complex pharmacy, sales, and operational data into actionable insights that inform decisions, improve performance, and drive business outcomes. Sitting at the intersection of business strategy, analytics, and technology, the Senior Analytics Consultant translates ambiguous business questions into analytical approaches, delivers decision-support solutions, and communicates the story behind the data to technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Responsibilities

Use your skills to make an impact


Lead complex analytical initiatives that support strategic business priorities and operational performance.
Serve as a consultative analytics partner to business leaders, helping define problems, identify opportunities, formulate hypotheses, and develop data-driven recommendations.
Independently lead analytics engagements from intake and discovery through analysis, solution development, stakeholder alignment, and delivery of business outcomes.
Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and key performance drivers.
Design and develop meaningful metrics, frameworks, dashboards, and decision-support tools.
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations tailored to executive, operational, and technical audiences.
Influence strategic decisions by providing insights that impact growth, profitability, customer outcomes, and operational efficiency.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of analytics experience or Master's degree and 3+ years of analytics experience.
Demonstrated ability to serve as a consultative analytics partner, working directly with business stakeholders to define problems, evaluate opportunities, and deliver actionable recommendations.
Experience leading projects through the full analytics lifecycle, including business intake, discovery, analysis, solution development, communication of insights, and implementation support.
Progressive experience in analytics, business intelligence, informatics, pharmacy analytics, sales analytics, or a related field.
Strong proficiency with SQL, reporting and visualization tools, and analytical methodologies.
Experience communicating insights and recommendations to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications


Advanced degree in Informatics, Analytics, Business Analytics, Healthcare Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
Experience working with pharmacy, payer, provider, sales, or operational data.
Demonstrated intellectual curiosity and continuous learning with the ability to rapidly learn new business domains and analytical approaches.
Experience using SQL, Power BI, Databricks, Python, or similar tools to support business decision-making.


Role Clarification

This role is best suited for candidates who are energized by consultative analytics, business problem solving, and decision support. This is an individual contributor role focused on using data to solve high-impact business problems. While the role requires strong SQL skills to query, analyze, and work with large datasets, the primary focus is not pipeline development, infrastructure engineering, or software development.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Remote)
Description:
The Senior Data Analyst will help build trusted Finance data products and expand self-service analytics across FP&A. Working within the enterprise architecture and standards established by Shared Data Services, this role will translate Finance needs into scalable data solutions, validate and operationalize delivered assets, and directly build data models, transformations, pipelines, and dashboards when needed.

This is a highly technical individual-contributor role combining hands-on SQL and Python development, advanced analytics, data quality, business intelligence, and stakeholder partnership. The role will help Finance move from manual and fragmented analysis toward reusable data products that support driver-based forecasting, portfolio performance analysis, ad hoc decision support, and executive reporting.

Primary Responsibilities

Build Trusted Finance Data Products


Build, enhance, and maintain Finance tables, views, transformations, pipelines, and analytical models within established enterprise architecture, security, development, and governance standards.
Develop reusable data products supporting bookings, customers, billing, revenue, operational activity, and portfolio performance.
Use SQL and Python to automate data preparation, validation, and analytical workflows, and convert repeatable analyses into scalable assets.
Apply appropriate source control, testing, deployment, monitoring, and documentation practices to Finance data products.


Partner, Validate, and Operationalize


Translate FP&A and Portfolio Analytics needs into clear source requirements, data grain, business rules, transformation logic, quality controls, and acceptance criteria.
Own Finance requirements, prioritization, validation, and acceptance for data products delivered in partnership with onshore and offshore Shared Data Services teams.
Reconcile outputs to source systems, financial reporting, operational reporting, and approved methodologies; identify and resolve data quality issues, logic gaps, hierarchy problems, and incomplete coverage.
Maintain documentation for metric definitions, data lineage, business rules, assumptions, and known limitations, and coordinate issue resolution through Finance sign-off.


Deliver Advanced Analytics and Self-Service


Use SQL, Python, and appropriate analytical methods to solve complex customer, revenue, pricing, forecasting, portfolio, and operational questions.
Build semantic models, dashboards, and analytical tools using Power BI or a comparable enterprise business intelligence platform.
Enable FP&A users to independently answer recurring business questions with trusted data, reducing manual extracts, spreadsheet-based preparation, and one-off reporting.
Use approved AI-assisted development tools to improve coding, testing, documentation, and analytical productivity while validating outputs and protecting confidential data.


Education and Experience


Bachelor's degree in a technical, quantitative, analytical, Finance, or business discipline; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
Five or more years of relevant experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience independently delivering complex data and analytical solutions. Finance, FP&A, commercial analytics, or executive reporting experience is helpful but not required.


Required Qualifications


Advanced SQL and strong dimensional and analytical data-modeling skills.
Proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, and advanced analytics.
Experience developing or supporting ETL/ELT pipelines and reusable analytical datasets.
Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data warehouse or lakehouse environment.
Experience with data reconciliation, quality assurance, troubleshooting, and documentation.
Experience developing semantic models, dashboards, or business intelligence solutions.
Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into scalable analytical and technical solutions.
Familiarity with source control, testing, deployment, and production support practices.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Microsoft Fabric and Azure data services, including lakehouses, warehouses, notebooks, pipelines, or related analytical workloads.
Power BI experience, including semantic modeling and DAX.
Experience with Git, CI/CD, orchestration, monitoring, or production support.
Experience supporting Finance, FP&A, commercial analytics, or executive reporting.
Familiarity with forecasting, customer analytics, revenue analytics, or portfolio analytics.
Experience working with centralized or shared enterprise data teams.


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Strong technical problem-solving skills and the ability to execute independently.
Consultative approach and the ability to communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
Strong attention to data accuracy, controls, validation, and methodological consistency.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies, and deliverables with clear follow-through.
Curiosity, sound judgment, and a bias toward action and iterative delivery.
Ability to learn new technologies, data sources, and business concepts quickly.

Overview

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter. Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.

The Joint, Office of the Secretary of Defense, Interagency Division provides expert support services to a range of customers spanning across the Department of Defense, Federal Civilian, and international markets. JOID provides a diverse portfolio of analytical and programmatic capabilities to help our customers make informed decisions on their most challenging issues.

The Industry and Security Analysis Group (ISAG) within JOID provides analytical, technical, and program support to promote, grow, and protect the U.S. industrial base. ISAG’s support spans the Department of Defense (DOD), Department of Commerce, and other agencies to deliver critical decision support to national security leaders. Our team informs policy decisions, enables execution of comprehensive strategies and monitors and reports on the effectiveness of implementation. This enables senior leaders to execute strategies for developing and sustaining a robust industrial base that meets our nation’s strategic resource objectives. From policy to practice, we are a team of economic and national security professionals providing innovative solutions for our Nation’s most pressing security challenges.

We have an immediate need for a Sr. Data Analyst to provide onsite support out of the Pentagon and/or Mark Center in Alexandria, VA.

Responsibilities

The Sr. Data Analyst will support the newly formed Assistant Secretary of War for International Armaments Cooperation. Provide a dedicated data analytics capability in converting large volumes of data from disparate sources into decision-quality products. Manage data extraction, cleansing, and normalization from Department of War data platforms and other validated sources to support analysis and visualization for senior government leaders. Sources include Project Management Resource Tools (PMRT), Foreign Military Sales Single Tracking System (STS), International Agreements Tracking System (IATS), and Advana. Assist with streamlining ASW IAC workflows via PowerBI and PowerAutomate tools.

Qualifications

Required:


Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field
3+ years of experience developing automated data pipelines, processing complex government datasets, and building business intelligence dashboards
Expert proficiency with PowerBI, PowerAutomate, and Sharepoint systems
Active Secret clearance
Able to work fully onsite based on client needs


Desired


Active TS/SCI clearance
5+ years of experience

At SPA, we strive to deliver a robust total compensation package that will attract and retain top talent. Description:
Piper Companies is seeking a Data Analyst to join a mission‑driven Digital Transformation team focused on reshaping how patients and providers interact through innovative digital solutions. This role plays a key part in enabling data‑driven decision making by transforming complex data into actionable insights that drive operational efficiency, product performance, and meaningful business outcomes. This position is fully remote, with occasional travel for team‑building on client site.

Overview

In this role, you will partner with product, clinical, operational, and analytics stakeholders to understand business objectives, prepare and model data, and deliver reporting that clearly communicates progress toward key product goals. You will support the development of KPIs, build Power BI dashboards, and provide analytical insights that guide product and operational decisions. You will work under the supervision of the Sr. Director of Data & Analytics and collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams across the organization.

Identify, define, and document key performance metrics for digital products, ensuring consistent and repeatable KPI definitions.
Clean, model, and prepare data from the enterprise data warehouse and other primary sources using SQL, Python/Pandas, and Databricks.
Develop, maintain, and optimize Power BI dashboards and visualizations that clearly communicate product performance to stakeholders.
Respond to ad‑hoc reporting requests by gathering and analyzing data to answer business and operational questions.
Communicate analytical findings through clear written summaries, presentations, and discussions with product, clinical, and operational teams.
Collaborate with data scientists and analytics staff to operationalize data workflows and support modeling efforts.
Partner with product teams to understand business needs, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide data‑driven recommendations.
Participate in departmental meetings, cross‑functional committees, and quality/service improvement initiatives.
Adhere to departmental policies, procedures, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
Perform additional duties as assigned.


Qualifications

Education & Training


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.


Experience


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis or a related field.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities


Strong data modeling and analysis skills, including experience with Databricks, Python/Pandas, and SQL.
Proficiency working with large relational databases (Microsoft SQL Server preferred).
Experience with version control tools such as GitHub or Azure DevOps.
Advanced Power BI skills, including building dashboards, visuals, and DAX measures.
Strong Excel proficiency.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights for diverse audiences.


Compensation & Benefits


Salary: $105,000 – $115,000 annually.
Work Environment: Fully remote with occasional travel for team‑building.
Comprehensive benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), PTO, holidays, and sick leave as required by law.

Title: Analyste de données / Data Analyst
Description:
***An English version will follow***




À propos de nous

Fondée en 2015, Data Sciences (DS) n'est pas une agence comme les autres. Nous sommes un groupe d’experts de pointe en analyse de données, en recherche, en marketing numérique et en campagnes d'engagement avec un objectif commun et ambitieux : inspirer des changements de comportement qui ont un impact réel.

Ensemble, nous offrons aux ONG canadiennes et internationales, aux partis politiques et aux grandes entreprises des conseils stratégiques et des analyses fondées sur des bases scientifiques rigoureuses. Notre but ? Les aider à mieux comprendre, mobiliser et approfondir leurs liens avec leurs clients et leurs parties prenantes.

Chez DS, on vit selon la « règle du campeur » : on s’engage à laisser chaque projet, partenariat et communauté dans un meilleur état qu'on l'a trouvé. Puisque notre mission est de comprendre l’humain, nous plaçons l’humain au premier plan. Ici, on valorise une culture de transparence, d’entraide et une bonne dose de memes sur Slack. Que ce soit lors de nos dîners d'été ou de nos pauses café virtuelles mensuelles, on priorise la connexion humaine autant que l'excellence technique.




Ce que nous offrons

** Échelle salariale : 80k - 95k CAD **
Un régime d'assurance médicale et dentaire compétitif, payé à 100 % par l'employeur.
Perkopolis: Un accès gratuit à une foule de rabais et d'économies sur les divertissements, les voyages, le magasinage et les produits de bien-être.
Mode de travail hybride avec un bureau dans le quartier St-Henri, approvisionné en collations et en café.
Une tonne d'activités et de traditions pour créer un environnement inclusif et divertissant.
Un ordinateur MacBook fourni dès ton arrivée.
3 semaines de vacances par année.
5 jours personnels à utiliser à ta discrétion.
Un environnement de travail dynamique où aucune journée ne se ressemble.
Des opportunités de croissance grâce au financement de cours, de conférences et de certifications.
Un bureau moderne avec une ambiance « startup ».
La chance de rejoindre une équipe multidisciplinaire en pleine croissance.




Description du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) analyste de données qui rejoindra notre équipe diversifiée et en pleine croissance à Montréal. La personne retenue sera responsable de l'exploitation des données des clients, afin de produire des rapports automatisés et des analyses personnalisées. Cette personne a de l'expérience dans la manipulation de grands ensembles de données, souvent complexes, autant structurées que non structurées. Nous recherchons des personnes d'horizons divers ayant des compétences démontrées en résolution de problèmes et en méthodes quantitatives. Nous valorisons la créativité, le travail acharné et l’excellence au travail. La personne idéale est très motivée, soucieuse du détail, curieuse et à la recherche de défis. Elle doit pouvoir travailler eﬃcacement avec les membres de nos équipes d'ingénierie des données, de recherche et de numérique.




Responsabilités

Interpréter les objectifs globaux du client et les traduire en exigences visant à fournir des renseignements (« insights ») et/ou à générer des gains d'eﬃcacité.
Accéder, comprendre, interroger et transformer des données provenant d’une grande variété de sources, chacune avec son propre ensemble de subtilités.
Concevoir, développer et déployer des rapports sur mesure et automatisés, dans le but de fournir aux clients des informations rapides et exploitables.
Concevoir et coordonner des protocoles expérimentaux dans divers départements afin d'identifier des gains d'eﬃcacité stratégiques.
Communiquer des idées et des méthodologies de manière claire et succincte, autant à un public technique que non-initié.
Participer à des projets spéciaux et autres tâches connexes selon les besoins.




Exigences

D’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes.
2+ ans d'expérience en rédaction de requêtes SQL complexes, pour transformer et extraire des données de bases de données relationnelles ou d'entrepôts de données.
Expérience en Python et/ou R afin de manipuler et analyser de grands ensembles de données.
Connaissance de techniques et de concepts statistiques.
Excellentes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale.
Bilinguisme français et anglais.
Capacité à collaborer avec les membres d’autres équipes.




La connaissance de la langue anglaise est exigée pour ce poste, car les fonctions de la personne titulaire nécessiteront des communications quotidiennes avec une clientèle majoritairement anglophone située à l'extérieur du Québec.




--




About Us

Established in 2015, Data Sciences (DS) isn’t your typical agency. We are a group of leading experts in the fields of data analytics, research, digital marketing and engagement campaigns that have a common, ambitious goal: driving meaningful behaviour change.

Together, we provide Canadian and international NGOs, political parties, and major companies with well-designed, scientifically sound guidance, research, analytics, and marketing, in order to help them understand, engage and deepen their relationships with their customers and stakeholders.

Our culture is built on the Campsite Rule: we are committed to leaving every project, partnership, and community better than we found it. Because our mission is to understand people, we put people first. We value a culture of transparency, mutual support, and a healthy dose of Slack memes. Whether we’re enjoying summer lunches, or connecting during monthly virtual coffee breaks, we prioritize human connection as much as technical excellence.




What We Offer

** Salary range: 80k - 95k CAD **
100% employer-paid competitive health package including Medical & Dental benefit.
Perkopolis: a free program with discounts and savings on entertainment, hotels, travel, shopping and health and wellness products.
Hybrid work model with a snacks-and-coffee-stocked office in Montreal’s St-Henri neighbourhood.
Many internal traditions to create an inclusive and fun environment.
A MacBook computer on your first day.
3 weeks vacation.
5 personal days to use at your discretion.
A fast-paced work environment where every day is different.
The opportunity for professional development through funded courses, conferences and certifications.
A startup office space and the opportunity to join a growing, multi-disciplinary team.




About The Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our diverse and rapidly growing team in Montreal. The successful applicant will be responsible for leveraging client data to produce rapid insights through automated reporting and custom analytics. This individual has experience manipulating large and often complex datasets, both structured and unstructured. We are looking for individuals from a wide range of backgrounds with demonstrated quantitative and problem-solving skills. We value creativity, hard work and on-the-job excellence. The ideal candidate is someone who is highly motivated, detail oriented, curious and who seeks to take on a challenging role. Looking for a career that challenges you, fosters growth, and recognizes your contributions—all while keeping things fun? At US HealthConnect (USH), we don’t just talk about our core values, we live them. We’re currently seeking qualified candidates for a Data Analyst in our Fort Washington office. This position reports directly to the Analytics Manager and will be responsible for data gathering, analysis, and reporting.




What a day in the life of a Data Analyst looks like:

Acquire data from various internal and external data sources
Create reports for internal teams/external clients
Identify, analyze, and interpret patterns in data sets using statistical techniques
Derive and communicate data insights
Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices related to data analysis and BI




Expectations of qualified candidates:

Have a bachelor’s degree (BS) in Mathematics or Computer Science
2+ years’ working experience as a Data Analyst or Data Scientist
Knowledge of Machine Learning is a plus
Knowledge of Query Languages such as SQL
Possesses strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate information with attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to generate information quickly and manage multiple projects at once
Ability to work extended hours as needed




What qualified candidates can expect:

Along with a competitive salary and benefits package, we offer a modern working environment that supports work/life balance. They value hard work and a positive, can-do attitude, and in return, fosters a fun, friendly, and team-oriented culture.




Interested? Please submit your resume and salary requirements. Submissions without salary requirements will not be considered. No phone calls please.
